description: Centralized ability data for character sheets.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可用附贈動作進入狂怒。未穿著重甲時，獲得以下效果：

• 力量檢定與力量豁免具有優勢
• 以力量進行近戰武器攻擊並命中時，傷害獲得狂怒加值
• 對鈍擊、穿刺與揮砍傷害具有抗性

狂怒持續 1 分鐘，也可用附贈動作提早結束。狂怒期間無法施法或專注於法術。1 級時，每次長休前可狂怒兩次；次數會隨等級提高。
abilities.desc_en:
You can enter a rage as a bonus action. While not wearing heavy armor, you gain these benefits:

• Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws
• A rage damage bonus when you hit with a melee weapon attack using Strength
• Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage

Rage lasts for 1 minute, and you can also end it early as a bonus action. You cannot cast or concentrate on spells while raging. At 1st level, you can rage twice per long rest; this number increases with level.

abilities.desc_zh: 未穿著護甲時，護甲等級為 10 + 敏捷調整值 + 體魄調整值。使用盾牌不會失去此效果。
abilities.desc_en: While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You can still use a shield and gain this benefit.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第二級，當附近的事物不正常時，你會獲得一種不可思議的感覺，這讓你在躲避危險時獲得優勢。對於你能看到的效果，例如陷阱和法術，你在敏捷豁免檢定上有優勢。為了獲得這種好處，你不能失明、耳聾或喪失能力。
abilities.desc_en: At 2nd level, you gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger. You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 2 級開始，你可以拋開所有防禦的顧慮，進行猛烈的絕望攻擊。當你在回合中進行第一次攻擊時，你可以決定魯莽地攻擊。這樣做可以讓你在本回合使用力量進行近戰武器攻擊檢定時獲得優勢，但對你的攻擊檢定在你的下一個回合之前具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 2nd level, you can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第3級選擇這條路開始，當你狂怒時，你會陷入狂亂。如果你這樣做，在你的狂怒持續時間內，你可以在這之後的每個回合中進行一次近戰武器攻擊，作為附贈動作。當你的狂怒結束時，你會感到某種程度的力竭。
abilities.desc_en: Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的道路尋求與自然世界的協調，讓你與野獸有親緣關係。在第 3 級，當你採用這條道路時，你獲得了施展野獸感知和與動物交談法術的能力，但只能作為儀式，如第 10 章所述。
abilities.desc_en: Yours is a path that seeks attunement with the natural world, giving you a kinship with beasts. At 3rd level when you adopt this path, you gain the ability to cast the beast sense and speak with animals spells, but only as rituals, as described in chapter 10.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第3級，當你選擇這條道路時，你選擇了一個圖騰精神並獲得了它的特徵。你必須製作或獲得一個實體圖騰物品——護身符或類似的裝飾品——其中包含圖騰動物的毛皮或羽毛、爪子、牙齒或骨頭。根據你的選擇，你還可以獲得一些次要的身體屬性，這些屬性會讓人想起你的圖騰精神。例如，如果你有熊圖騰精神​​，你可能會異常多毛和厚皮膚，或者如果你的圖騰是鷹，你的眼睛會變成亮黃色。

你的圖騰動物可能與此處列出的動物有關，但更適合你的祖國。例如，你可以選擇鷹或禿鷹來代替老鷹。
abilities.desc_en:
At 3rd level, when you adopt this path, you choose a totem spirit and gain its feature. You must make or acquire a physical totem object—an amulet or similar adornment—that incorporates fur or feathers, claws, teeth, or bones of the totem animal. At your option, you also gain minor physical attributes that are reminiscent of your totem spirit. For example, if you have a bear totem spirit, you might be unusually hairy and thick-skinned, or if your totem is the eagle, your eyes turn bright yellow.

Your totem animal might be an animal related to those listed here but more appropriate to your homeland. For example, you could choose a hawk or vulture in place of an eagle.

abilities.desc_zh: 狂怒時，你對心靈傷害以外的所有傷害都有抵抗力。熊的精神使你夠堅強，能夠承受任何懲罰。
abilities.desc_en: While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic damage. The spirit of the bear makes you tough enough to stand up to any punishment.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你狂怒且沒有穿著重甲時，其他生物在針對你的機會攻擊檢定上處於劣勢，並且你可以在你的回合中使用衝刺動作作為附贈動作。鷹的精神使你成為掠食者，可以輕鬆地在戰鬥中穿梭。
abilities.desc_en: While you're raging and aren't wearing heavy armor, other creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you, and you can use the Dash action as a bonus action on your turn. The spirit of the eagle makes you into a predator who can weave through the fray with ease.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你狂怒且沒有穿著重甲時，你的行走速度會增加 15 呎。麋鹿的精神使你異常敏捷。
abilities.desc_en: While you're raging and aren't wearing heaving armor, your walking speed increases by 15 feet. The spirit of the elk makes you extraordinarily swift.

abilities.desc_zh: 在狂怒時，你的跳遠距離可以增加 10 呎，跳高距離可以增加 3 呎。老虎的精神賦予你跳躍的力量。
abilities.desc_en: While raging, you can add 10 feet to your long jump distance and 3 feet to your high jump distance. The spirit of the tiger empowers your leaps.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你狂怒時，你的朋友在對你 5 呎內任何對你有敵意的生物進行近戰攻擊檢定時具有優勢。狼的精神使你成為獵人的領袖。
abilities.desc_en: While you're raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you. The spirit of the wolf makes you a leader of hunters.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，當你不穿著重甲時，你的速度會增加 10 呎。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 5th level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 從等級 6 開始，你在狂怒時無法被魅惑或驚嚇。如果你在進入狂怒狀態時受到魅惑或恐懼，則效果會在狂怒持續時間內暫停。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 6th level, you can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 6 級，你將根據你選擇的圖騰動物獲得神奇的好處。你可以選擇與第 3 級選擇的動物相同的動物，也可以選擇不同的動物。
abilities.desc_en: At 6th level, you gain a magical benefit based on the totem animal of your choice. You can choose the same animal you selected at 3rd level or a different one.

abilities.desc_zh: 你獲得了熊的力量。你的承載能力（包括最大負載和最大升力）加倍，並且你在推、拉、舉起或打破物體的力量檢定中具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: You gain the might of a bear. Your carrying capacity (including maximum load and maximum lift) is doubled, and you have advantage on Strength checks made to push, pull, lift, or break objects.

abilities.desc_zh: 你獲得了鷹的視力。你可以毫無困難地看到 1 英里以外的地方，甚至能夠辨別細微的細節，就像看著距離你不超過 100 呎的東西一樣。此外，昏暗的光線不會對你的感知（感知）檢查造成不利影響。
abilities.desc_en: You gain the eyesight of an eagle. You can see up to 1 mile away with no difficulty, able to discern even fine details as though looking at something no more than 100 feet away from you. Additionally, dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks.

abilities.desc_zh: 無論騎馬還是步行，你的行進速度都會加倍，最多 10 個同伴在距你 60 呎以內且你沒有喪失行動能力的情況下，行進速度也會加倍。麋鹿精神可以幫助你漫遊又遠又快。
abilities.desc_en: Whether mounted or on foot, your travel pace is doubled, as is the travel pace of up to ten companions while they're within 60 feet of you and you're not incapacitated. The elk spirit helps you roam far and fast.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以熟練以下清單中的兩項技能：田徑、雜技、潛行和生存。貓精神磨練你的生存本能。
abilities.desc_en: You gain proficiency in two skills from the following list: Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth, and Survival. The cat spirit hones your survival instincts.

abilities.desc_zh: 你獲得了狼的狩獵敏感性。你可以在快速行進時追蹤其他生物，也可以在正常速度行進時隱密移動。
abilities.desc_en: You gain the hunting sensibilities of a wolf. You can track other creatures while traveling at a fast pace, and you can move stealthily while traveling at a normal pace.

abilities.desc_zh:
到了 7 級，你的直覺已經磨練，你在主動擲骰上有優勢。

此外，如果你在戰鬥開始時感到驚訝並且沒有喪失行為能力，那麼你可以在第一個回合中正常行動，但前提是你在該回合中先進入狂怒狀態，然後再做任何其他事情。
abilities.desc_en:
By 7th level, your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls.

Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 9 級開始，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲出一個額外的武器傷害骰子。

這會在 13 級時增加兩個骰子，在 17 級時增加三個骰子。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 10 級開始，你可以用你的行動用你的威脅性的存在來嚇唬別人。當你這樣做時，選擇一個你在 30 呎範圍內可以看到的生物。如果該生物能看到或聽到你，它必須通過感知豁免檢定（DC等於8+你的熟練加值+你的魅力調整值），否則就會害怕你，直到你的下回合結束。在隨後的回合中，你可以使用你的行動來延長受驚生物身上的此效果的持續時間，直到你的下一個回合結束。如果生物在視線之外或距離你超過 60 呎時結束回合，則此效果結束。

如果生物成功通過豁免檢定，則你在 24 小時內無法再次對該生物使用此特性。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 10th level, you can use your action to frighten someone with your menacing presence. When you do so, choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to extend the duration of this effect on the frightened creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn out of line of sight or more than 60 feet away from you.

If the creature succeeds on its saving throw, you can't use this feature on that creature again for 24 hours.

abilities.desc_zh: 10級時，你可以施放自然公社法術，但只能作為儀式。當你這樣做時，你為圖騰之靈或野獸之相選擇的動物之一的精神版本會出現在你面前，傳達你所尋求的信息。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you can cast the commune with nature spell, but only as a ritual. When you do so, a spiritual version of one of the animals you chose for Totem Spirit or Aspect of the Beast appears to you to convey the information you seek.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 11 級開始，你的狂怒可以讓你在受重傷的情況下繼續戰鬥。如果你在狂怒時生命值降至 0 並且沒有直接死亡，你可以進行 DC 10 的體質豁免。如果你成功了，你的生命值就會降到 1。

第一次使用此特性後，每次使用此特性，DC 都會增加 5。當你完成短暫或長休後，DC 會重設為 10。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 11th level, your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you're raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.

abilities.desc_zh: 現在，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲兩個額外的武器傷害骰子。
abilities.desc_en: You now roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 14 級開始，當你受到距你 5 呎以內的生物傷害。你可以利用你的反應對該生物進行近戰武器攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 14th level, when you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you. you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 14 級，你將獲得基於你選擇的圖騰動物的魔法好處。你可以選擇與先前選擇的動物相同或不同的動物。
abilities.desc_en: At 14th level, you gain a magical benefit based on a totem animal of your choice. You can choose the same animal you selected previously or a different one.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你狂怒時，任何距離你 5 呎以內對你有敵意的生物在針對你或其他具有此特性的角色以外的目標的攻擊檢定上都會處於劣勢。如果敵人看不到或聽不到你或不能被嚇到，那麼它就不會受到此效果的影響。
abilities.desc_en: While you're raging, any creature within 5 feet of you that's hostile to you has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another character with this feature. An enemy is immune to this effect if it can't see or hear you or if it can't be frightened.

abilities.desc_zh: 狂怒時，你的飛行速度等於你目前的步行速度。這種好處只能在短時間內發揮作用；如果你在空中結束轉彎而沒有其他東西支撐你，你就會墜落。
abilities.desc_en: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed. This benefit works only in short bursts; you fall if you end your turn in the air and nothing else is holding you aloft.

abilities.desc_zh: 狂怒時，你可以在移動過程中使用附贈動作穿過大型或小型生物的空間。該生物必須成功通過力量豁免檢定（DC 8 + 你的力量加值 + 你的熟練加值），否則就會被擊倒並受到等於 1d12 + 你的力量調整值的鈍擊傷害。
abilities.desc_en: While raging, you can use a bonus action during your move to pass through the space of a Large or smaller creature. That creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength bonus + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked prone and take bludgeoning damage equal to 1d12 + your strength modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你狂怒時，如果你在對大型或小型目標進行近戰武器攻擊之前向其直線移動至少 20 呎，則可以使用附贈動作對其進行額外的近戰武器攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: While you're raging, if you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a Large or smaller target right before making a melee weapon attack against it, you can use a bonus action to make an additional melee weapon attack against it.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你狂怒時，當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中大型或小型生物時，你可以在回合中使用附贈動作將其擊倒。
abilities.desc_en: While you're raging, you can use a bonus action on your turn to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with melee weapon attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 15 級開始，你的狂怒如此猛烈，只有當你失去知覺或選擇結束它時，它才會提前結束。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 15th level, your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.

abilities.desc_zh: 現在，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲出三個額外的武器傷害骰子。
abilities.desc_en: You now roll three additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，如果你的力量檢定總分低於你的力量分數，你可以使用該分數來代替總分。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 18th level, if your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

abilities.desc_zh: 20級時，你體現了荒野的力量。你的力量和體質分數增加 4。你這些分數的最大值現在為 24。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, you embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

abilities.desc_zh: 吟遊激勵的使用次數等於魅力調整值，至少一次，完成長休後恢復。你可用附贈動作選擇 60 呎內一名能聽見你的其他生物；該生物在 10 分鐘內可將一顆吟遊激勵骰（1 級時為 d6）加到一次能力檢定、攻擊檢定或豁免結果中。
abilities.desc_en: You can use Bardic Inspiration a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, with a minimum of once, and regain all uses after a long rest. As a bonus action, choose another creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Within 10 minutes, it can add one Bardic Inspiration die—a d6 at 1st level—to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 2 級開始，你可以將一半的熟練加值（無條件捨去）添加到你進行的任何不包括熟練加值的能力檢查中。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 2 級開始，你可以在短休期間使用舒緩的音樂或演講來幫助受傷的盟友恢復活力。如果你或任何能聽到你表演的友方生物在短休結束時透過花費生命骰來恢復生命值，那麼每個生物都會額外恢復 1d6 生命值。

當你達到該職業的特定等級時，額外生命值會增加：9級時增加到1d8，13級時增加到1d10，17級時增加到1d12。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 2nd level, you can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points by spending Hit Dice at the end of the short rest, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

The extra hit points increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 3 級，選擇你的兩項技能熟練程度。對於你使用任一所選熟練程度進行的任何能力檢查，你的熟練加值都會加倍。

在 10 級時，你可以選擇另外兩種技能熟練程度來獲得此好處。
abilities.desc_en:
At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies to gain this benefit.

abilities.desc_zh: 同樣在第三級，你將學習如何運用你的智慧來分散、迷惑或削弱他人的信心和能力。當你在 60 呎內可以看到的生物進行攻擊檢定、能力檢定或傷害檢定時，你可以使用你的反應來消耗你的吟遊靈感的使用次數，投擲一個吟遊靈感骰子，並從該生物的擲骰中減去擲出的數字。你可以選擇在生物進行檢定之後、DM 確定攻擊檢定或能力檢定成功或失敗之前，或是在生物造成傷害之前使用此特性。如果該生物聽不到你的聲音或免疫被魅惑，則該生物免疫。
abilities.desc_en: Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can't hear you or if it's immune to being charmed.

abilities.desc_zh: 同樣在第三級，你學會在戰鬥中激勵他人。擁有吟遊詩人靈感骰子的生物可以擲骰子並將擲出的數字加到它剛剛進行的武器傷害擲骰中。或者，當該生物進行攻擊檢定時，它可以在看到檢定之後但在知道它是否擊中或未擊中之前，使用其反應來投擲吟遊詩人靈感骰子，並將投擲的數字添加到其對抗該攻擊的AC中。
abilities.desc_en: Also at 3rd level, you learn to inspire others in battle. A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can roll that die and add the number rolled to a weapon damage roll it just made. Alternatively, when an attack roll is made against the creature, it can use its reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 5 級，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 5th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d8.

abilities.desc_zh: 從你達到第 5 級開始，當你完成短期或長期休息時，你會恢復所有已消耗的吟遊詩人靈感的使用量。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 6 級，你獲得使用音符或力量話語來破壞影響心靈的效果的能力。作為一個動作，你可以開始一場持續到下一個回合結束的表演。在此期間，你和周圍 30 呎內的任何友方生物在對抗驚嚇或魅惑的豁免檢定上都有優勢。生物必須能夠聽到你的聲音才能獲得此好處。如果你喪失行為能力或保持沉默，或者你自願結束表演（無需採取任何行動），表演將提前結束。
abilities.desc_en: At 6th level, you gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. A creature must be able to hear you to gain this benefit. The performance ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced or if you voluntarily end it (no action required).

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 6 級，你可以從任意職業中選擇兩種法術。你選擇的法術必須具有你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，但不計入你所知道的吟遊詩人法術數量。
abilities.desc_en: At 6th level, you learn two spells of your choice from any class. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip. The chosen spells count as bard spells for you but don't count against the number of bard spells you know.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 6 級開始，每當你在自己的回合進行攻擊動作時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 9級時，從《安息之歌》中獲得的額外生命值增加至1d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 9th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d8.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 10 級時，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d10。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d10.

abilities.desc_zh: 10級時，你可以選擇另外兩種技能熟練度。對於你使用任一所選熟練程度進行的任何能力檢查，你的熟練加值都會加倍。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

abilities.desc_zh:
到了 10 級，你已經從廣泛的學科中掠奪了魔法知識。從任意職業中選擇兩個法術，包括這個。你選擇的法術必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。

你可以在 14 級從任何職業學習兩個額外的法術，並在 18 級再次學習。
abilities.desc_en:
By 10th level, you have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.

You learn two additional spells from any class at 14th level and again at 18th level.

abilities.desc_zh: 13級時，從《安息之歌》中獲得的額外生命值增加到1d10。
abilities.desc_en: At 13th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d10.

abilities.desc_zh:
14級時，從任意職業中選擇兩個額外法術，包括這個。你選擇的法術必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。
abilities.desc_en:
At 14th level, choose two additional spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 14 級開始，當你進行能力檢定時，你可以消耗一次吟遊靈感。擲出一個吟遊詩人靈感骰子，並將擲出的數字加到你的能力檢定中。你可以選擇在擲骰子進行能力檢查之後、DM 告訴你成功或失敗之前執行此操作。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 14th level, when you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to your ability check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the DM tells you whether you succeed or fail.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 14 級時，你已經掌握了將施法和武器使用融為一體的藝術。當你使用動作施展吟遊詩人法術時，你可以進行一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。
abilities.desc_en: At 14th level, you have mastered the art of weaving spellcasting and weapon use into a single harmonious act. When you use your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 15 級，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d12。
abilities.desc_en: At 15th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d12.

abilities.desc_zh: 17級時，從《安息之歌》獲得的額外生命值增加至1d12。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d12.

abilities.desc_zh:
18級時，從任意職業中選擇兩個額外的法術，包括這個。你選擇的法術必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。
abilities.desc_en:
At 18th level, choose two additional spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 20 級，當你投出主動權且吟遊詩人靈感已用完時，你會重新獲得一次使用權。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第一級，你可以選擇學習兩種語言。你還可以熟練選擇以下技能中的兩種：奧秘、歷史、自然或宗教。

對於任何使用這些技能的能力檢定，你的熟練加值都會加倍。
abilities.desc_en:
At 1st level, you learn two languages of your choice. You also become proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.

Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those skills.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在第一級選擇這個領域時，你就會獲得重甲的熟練程度。
abilities.desc_en: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 同樣從 1 級開始，你的治療法術會更有效。每當你使用1級或更高等級的法術來恢復生物的生命值時，該生物會恢復等於2+法術等級的額外生命值。
abilities.desc_en: Also starting at 1st level, your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

abilities.desc_zh: 当你在第一级选择这个领域时，如果你还不知道的话，你就会获得光咒术。
abilities.desc_en: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain the light cantrip if you don't already know it.

abilities.desc_zh:
同样在第一级，你可以在自己和攻击的敌人之间插入神圣之光。當你受到你能看到的 30 呎範圍內的生物攻擊時，你可以利用你的反應對攻擊檢定施加不利影響，在攻擊者擊中或未擊中之前導致光線在攻擊者面前閃爍。无法被蒙蔽的攻击者不会受到此特性的影响。

你可以使用该特性的次数等于你的感知调整值（至少一次）。完成長休後，你將恢復所有消耗的用途。
abilities.desc_en:
Also at 1st level, you can interpose divine light between yourself and an attacking enemy. When you are attacked by a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, causing light to flare before the attacker before it hits or misses. An attacker that can't be blinded is immune to this feature.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第一級，你可以學習一種你選擇的德魯伊戲法。你還可以熟練以下你選擇的技能之一：動物處理、自然或生存。
abilities.desc_en: At 1st level, you learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

abilities.desc_zh: 同樣在第一級，你可以熟練使用重甲。
abilities.desc_en: Also at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

abilities.desc_zh:
同樣在第一級，你可以雷霆般地斥責攻擊者。當你能看到的距離你 5 呎以內的生物攻擊你時，你可以利用你的反應來讓生物進行敏捷豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物會受到 2d8 閃電或雷霆傷害（由你選擇），豁免成功時則受到一半傷害。

你可以使用該特性的次數等於你的感知調整值（至少一次）。完成長休後，你將恢復所有消耗的用途。
abilities.desc_en:
Also at 1st level, you can thunderously rebuke attackers. When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to cause the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (your choice) on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在第一級選擇這個領域時開始，你可以用你的動作去觸摸除你自己之外的自願生物，以使其在敏捷（潛行）檢定上獲得優勢。此祝福持續1小時或直到你再次使用此特性。
abilities.desc_en: Starting when you choose this domain at 1st level, you can use your action to touch a willing creature other than yourself to give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This blessing lasts for 1 hour or until you use this feature again.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第一級開始，當你投入戰鬥時，你的神會帶給你靈感。當你使用攻擊動作時，你可以將一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。你可以使用該特性的次數等於你的感知調整值（至少一次）。完成長休後，你將恢復所有消耗的用途。
abilities.desc_en: From 1st level, your god delivers bolts of inspiration to you while you are engaged in battle. When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第2級，你獲得直接從你的神靈引導神聖能量的能力，使用該能量來增強魔法效果。你從兩個這樣的效果開始：驅散不死和由你的領域決定的效果。某些領域會隨著你等級的提升而授予你額外的效果，如領域描述中所述。

當你使用通道神性時，你可以選擇要建立的效果。然後，你必須完成短休或長休才能再次使用你的通道神性。

某些引導神性效果需要豁免檢定。當你使用此類效果時，DC 等於你的牧師法術豁免 DC。

從 6 級開始，你可以在休息之間使用神通兩次，從 18 級開始，你可以在休息之間使用 3 次。當你完成短休或長休後，你將恢復消耗的使用量。
abilities.desc_en:
At 2nd level, you gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain. Some domains grant you additional effects as you advance in levels, as noted in the domain description.

When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again.

Some Channel Divinity effects require saving throws. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your cleric spell save DC.

Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level, you can use it three times between rests. When you finish a short or long rest, you regain your expended uses.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並說出譴責不死生物的祈禱文。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到或聽到你的不死生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它將被翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到任何傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。
abilities.desc_en:
As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

abilities.title_en: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
abilities.desc_zh: 從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的神性通道來挖掘神聖的知識之井。作為一項行動，你選擇一項技能或工具。在 10 分鐘內，你可以熟練所選的技能或工具。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to tap into a divine well of knowledge. As an action, you choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with the chosen skill or tool.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 2 級開始，你可以使用神通來治癒重傷者。

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並喚起治療能量，可以恢復相當於你牧師等級五倍的生命值。選擇任何距離你 30 呎以內的生物，並將這些生命值分配給它們。此特性可以將生物恢復到不超過其最大生命值的一半。你不能在不死生物或構造體上使用此特性。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and evoke healing energy that can restore a number of hit points equal to five times your cleric level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those hit points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.

abilities.title_en: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
abilities.desc_zh:
從 2 級開始，你可以使用你的神力引導陽光，驅逐黑暗並對你的敵人造成輻射傷害。

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽，你周圍 30 呎內的任何魔法黑暗都會被驅散。此外，距離你 30 呎內的每個敵對生物都必須進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，生物會受到等於 2d10 + 你的牧師等級的光輝傷害，成功時則受到一半傷害。受到你完全掩護的生物不受影響。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to harness sunlight, banishing darkness and dealing radiant damage to your foes.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and any magical darkness within 30 feet of you is dispelled. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes radiant damage equal to 2d10 + your cleric level on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has total cover from you is not affected.

abilities.title_en: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
abilities.desc_zh:
從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的神通來迷惑動物和植物。

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並呼喚你神的名字。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到你的野獸或植物生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它會被你魅惑 1 分鐘或直到它受到傷害。當它被你魅惑時，它對你和你指定的其他生物很友好。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to charm animals and plants.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and invoke the name of your deity. Each beast or plant creature that can see you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is charmed by you for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While it is charmed by you, it is friendly to you and other creatures you designate.

abilities.desc_zh:
從等級 2 開始，你可以使用你的引導神性來肆無忌憚地運用風暴的力量。

當你滾動閃電或雷霆傷害時，你可以使用你的引導神力來造成最大傷害，而不是滾動。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to wield the power of the storm with unchecked ferocity.

When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

abilities.title_zh: 引導神性：喚起口是心非
abilities.desc_zh:
從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的通道神性來創造你自己的虛幻複製品。

作為一個動作，你創造了一個完美的自我幻象，持續一分鐘，或直到你失去注意力（就好像你正在專注於一個法術）。幻像出現在你周圍 30 呎內可見的無人空間。作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以將幻象移動到 30 呎之外的你能看到的空間，但它必須保持在距離你 120 呎的範圍內。

在此期間，你可以像在幻象空間中一樣施展法術，但你必須使用自己的感官。此外，當你和你的幻像都在距離能看到幻象的生物 5 呎以內時，考慮到幻象對目標的干擾程度，你在針對該生物的攻擊檢定上具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to create an illusory duplicate of yourself.

As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 feet of you.

For the duration, you can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses. Additionally, when both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature, given how distracting the illusion is to the target.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的通道神性以超自然的準確性進行攻擊。當你進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的引導神性來獲得+10的檢定加值。你可以在看到擲骰後、DM 說出攻擊是否命中或未命中之前做出選擇。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy. When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，當 CR 1/2 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 5th level, when an undead of CR 1/2 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 6 級開始，你可以在休息期間使用你的引導神力兩次。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 6 級，你可以使用你的神性引導來讀取生物的想法。然後你可以使用你對生物思想的存取來命令它。

作為一個動作，選擇一個你在 60 呎範圍內可以看到的生物。該生物必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物成功通過豁免檢定，則在完成長休之前，你無法再次對其使用此特性。

如果該生物的豁免失敗，當它在距離你 60 呎以內時，你可以讀取它表面的想法（那些最重要的思想，反映它當前的情緒和它正在積極思考的事情）。此效果持續1分鐘。

在此期間，你可以用你的動作結束這個效果，並向該生物施放暗示法術，而無需消耗法術位。目標對該法術的豁免檢定自動失敗。
abilities.desc_en:
At 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to read a creature's thoughts. You can then use your access to the creature's mind to command it.

As an action, choose one creature that you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature succeeds on the saving throw, you can't use this feature on it again until you finish a long rest.

If the creature fails its save, you can read its surface thoughts (those foremost in its mind, reflecting its current emotions and what it is actively thinking about) when it is within 60 feet of you. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

During that time, you can use your action to end this effect and cast the suggestion spell on the creature without expending a spell slot. The target automatically fails its saving throw against the spell.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 6 級開始，你對其他人施展的治療法術也會治癒你。當你施展 1 級或更高等級的法術為你以外的生物恢復生命值時，你恢復的生命值等於 2 + 法術等級。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 6th level, the healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 6 級開始，當你在 30 呎內可以看到的生物攻擊除你以外的生物時，你還可以使用你的防護耀斑特性。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 6th level, you can also use your Warding Flare feature when a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you attacks a creature other than you.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 6 級開始，當你或周圍 30 呎內的生物受到酸、冷、火、閃電或雷霆傷害時，你可以使用你的反應來賦予該生物抵抗該傷害的能力。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 6th level, when you or a creature within 30 feet of you takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant resistance to the creature against that instance of the damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 6 級，當你對大型或小型生物造成閃電傷害時，你也可以將其推離你 10 呎。
abilities.desc_en: At 6th level, when you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 feet away from you.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 6 級開始，你可以使用你的引導神力來消失。

作為一個動作，你將變得隱身，直到下一回合結束。如果你攻擊或施展法術，你就會變得可見。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to vanish.

As an action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn. You become visible if you attack or cast a spell.

abilities.desc_zh: 6級時，當你周圍30呎內的生物進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的引導神力，利用你的反應為生物提供+10的檢定加值。你可以在看到擲骰後、DM 說出攻擊是否命中或未命中之前做出選擇。
abilities.desc_en: At 6th level, when a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to the roll, using your Channel Divinity. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 8 級開始，當 CR 1 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 8th level, when an undead of CR 1 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

abilities.desc_zh: 從等級 8 開始，你將你的感知調整值加到你對任何牧師戲法造成的傷害上。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 光輝傷害。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

abilities.desc_zh: 從等級 8 開始，你將你的感知調整值加到你對任何牧師戲法造成的傷害上。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 寒冷、火焰或閃電傷害（由你選擇）。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage (your choice) to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。每個回合一次，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外 1d8 雷霆傷害。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入毒液的能力——這是你神的禮物。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 毒害傷害。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with poison—a gift from your deity. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 poison damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 點傷害，傷害類型與武器所造成的傷害相同。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。
abilities.desc_en: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 10 級開始，當你有很大需要時，你可以召喚你的神來介入。

祈求神的幫助需要你採取行動。描述你尋求的幫助，並擲百分骰子。如果你擲出的數字等於或低於你的牧師等級，你的神就會介入。 DM 選擇介入的性質；任何牧師法術或牧師領域法術的效果都是適當的。如果你的神明干預，你將在 7 天內無法再次使用此特性。否則，你可以在完成長休後再次使用它。

在 20 級時，你的介入請求會自動成功，無需擲骰。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 10th level, you can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great.

Imploring your deity's aid requires you to use your action. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes. The DM chooses the nature of the intervention; the effect of any cleric spell or cleric domain spell would be appropriate. If your deity intervenes, you can't use this feature again for 7 days. Otherwise, you can use it again after you finish a long rest.

At 20th level, your call for intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 11 級開始，當 CR 2 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 11th level, when an undead of CR 2 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 14 級開始，當 CR 3 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 14th level, when an undead of CR 3 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 17 級開始，當 CR 4 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 17th level, when an undead of CR 4 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 17 級開始，你可以喚起與你所持有的物體或周圍環境有關的過去的幻象。你至少花一分鐘的時間進行冥想和祈禱，然後你會看到最近發生的事情的夢幻般、朦朧的一瞥。你可以用這種方式冥想幾分鐘，時間等於你的智慧值，並且在這段時間內必須保持專注，就像你在施展法術一樣。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 17th level, you can call up visions of the past that relate to an object you hold or your immediate surroundings. You spend at least 1 minute in meditation and prayer, then receive dreamlike, shadowy glimpses of recent events. You can meditate in this way for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom score and must maintain concentration during that time, as if you were casting a spell.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在冥想時拿著一個物體，你可以看到該物體前主人的幻象。冥想 1 分鐘後，你將了解所有者如何獲得和丟失該物品，以及最近涉及該物品和該所有者的重大事件。如果該物體最近被另一個生物擁有（在等於你的感知值的天數內），你可以為每個擁有者額外花費 1 分鐘來了解有關該生物的相同資訊。
abilities.desc_en: Holding an object as you meditate, you can see visions of the object's previous owner. After meditating for 1 minute, you learn how the owner acquired and lost the object, as well as the most recent significant event involving the object and that owner. If the object was owned by another creature in the recent past (within a number of days equal to your Wisdom score), you can spend 1 additional minute for each owner to learn the same information about that creature.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你冥想時，你會看到你附近最近發生的事件的景象（房間、街道、隧道、空地等，最大50呎的立方體），回溯到等於你的智慧分數的天數。冥想的每一分鐘，你都會了解一個重要事件，從最近的事件開始。重大事件通常涉及強烈的情感，例如戰鬥和背叛、婚姻和謀殺、出生和葬禮。然而，它們也可能包括更平凡的事件，但這些事件對你目前的情況來說很重要。
abilities.desc_en: As you meditate, you see visions of recent events in your immediate vicinity (a room, street, tunnel, clearing, or the like, up to a 50-foot cube), going back a number of days equal to your Wisdom score. For each minute you meditate, you learn about one significant event, beginning with the most recent. Significant events typically involve powerful emotions, such as battles and betrayals, marriages and murders, births and funerals. However, they might also include more mundane events that are nevertheless important in your current situation.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 17 級開始，當你通常會擲一個或多個骰子來用法術恢復生命值時，你會為每個骰子使用盡可能高的數字。例如，你不是為生物恢復 2d6 點生命值，而是恢復 12 點。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 17th level, when you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 hit points to a creature, you restore 12.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 17 級開始，你可以使用你的動作激活持續 1 分鐘的陽光光環，或者直到你使用另一個動作將其消除。你可以在 60 呎半徑範圍內發出明亮的光線，並在半徑 30 呎之外發出昏暗的光線。在明亮的光線下，你的敵人在對抗任何造成火焰或輻射傷害的法術的豁免檢定中處於劣勢。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 17th level, you can use your action to activate an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it using another action. You emit bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. Your enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 17級時，你獲得了指揮動物和植物生物的能力。當生物被你的魅力動物和植物特性迷惑時，你可以在你的回合中採取加值行動，口頭命令每個生物在下一個回合要做什麼。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you gain the ability to command animals and plant creatures. While creatures are charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants feature, you can take a bonus action on your turn to verbally command what each of those creatures will do on its next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 17級時，只要你不在地下或室內，你的飛行速度就等於你目前的步行速度。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed whenever you are not underground or indoors.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 17 級，當你使用「呼叫口是心非」時，你最多可以創造四個自己的複製品，而不是一個。作為輪到你的附贈動作，你可以將任意數量的它們移動到 30 呎，最大範圍為 120 呎。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you can create up to four duplicates of yourself, instead of one, when you use Invoke Duplicity. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move any number of them up to 30 feet, to a maximum range of 120 feet.

abilities.desc_zh: 17級時，你獲得對非魔法武器的鈍擊、穿刺和砍擊傷害的抗性。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，你可以在休息期間使用 3 次神通。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 18th level, you can use your Channel Divinity three times between rests.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 20 級時，你的介入請求會自動成功，無需擲骰。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, your call for intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.

abilities.desc_zh: 你懂德魯伊語（Druidic），可用它交談或留下秘密訊息。懂德魯伊語的人會自動發現這類訊息；其他生物必須通過 DC 15 感知（觀察）檢定才能發現，但若無魔法協助仍無法解讀。
abilities.desc_en: You know Druidic and can use it to speak or leave secret messages. Creatures that know Druidic notice such messages automatically. Others must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice one and cannot decipher it without magic.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 2 級開始，你可以用你的行動神奇地呈現你以前見過的野獸的形狀。你可以使用此特性兩次。當你完成短休或長休後，你將恢復已消耗的用途。

你的德魯伊等級決定了你可以變身的野獸，如野獸形狀表中所示。例如，在第 2 級，你可以變身為任何挑戰等級為 1/4 或更低但沒有飛行或游泳速度的野獸。

你可以保持野獸形態的時間等於你德魯伊等級的一半（無條件捨去）。然後你將恢復到正常形式，除非你再次使用此特性。你可以透過在你的回合中使用附贈動作來提前恢復到正常狀態。如果你失去知覺、生命值降至 0 或死亡，你會自動恢復。

當你變身時，以下規則適用：

• 你的遊戲統計數據會被野獸的統計數據所取代，但你會保留你的陣營、個性以及智力、感知和魅力分數。除了獲得該生物的技能和豁免能力之外，你還保留了所有技能和豁免能力。如果該生物與你具有相同的熟練度，並且其屬性塊中的加值高於你的，則使用該生物的加值而不是你的。如果生物具有任何傳奇或巢穴動作，則你無法使用它們。
• 當你變形時，你會假設野獸的生命值和生命骰。當你恢復正常形態時，你的生命值會恢復到變身前的水準。然而，如果你因生命值降至 0 而恢復，任何多餘的傷害都會轉入你的正常形態。例如，如果你在動物形態下受到 10 點傷害並且只剩下 1 點生命值，那麼你會恢復並受到 9 點傷害。只要超額傷害不會將你正常形態的生命值降低至 0，你就不會被擊昏。
• 你不能施展法術，並且你說話或採取任何需要雙手的行動的能力都受到你野獸形態的能力的限制。然而，變形並不會破壞你對已經施展的法術的注意力，也不會阻止你採取屬於法術一部分的動作，例如你已經施展的召喚閃電。
• 你保留了來自你的職業、種族或其他來源的任何特性的好處，並且可以使用它們（如果新形態在身體上有能力這樣做的話）。然而，你不能使用任何特殊感官，例如黑暗視覺，除非你的新形態也有這種感覺。
• 你可以選擇你的裝備是掉落在你所在空間的地面上、融入你的新形態還是被它磨損。磨損的裝備可以正常工作，但 DM 根據生物的形狀和大小來決定新形態佩戴一件裝備是否實用。你的裝備不會改變尺寸或形狀來匹配新形態，並且新形態無法穿戴的任何裝備都必須掉落到地面或與其合併。與形態融合的裝備在你離開形態之前不會產生任何效果。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

Your druid level determines the beasts you can transform into, as shown in the Beast Shapes table. At 2nd level, for example, you can transform into any beast that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower that doesn't have a flying or swimming speed.

You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die.

While you are transformed, the following rules apply:

• Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus instead of yours. If the creature has any legendary or lair actions, you can't use them.
• When you transform, you assume the beast's hit points and Hit Dice. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. However, if you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. For example, if you take 10 damage in animal form and have only 1 hit point left, you revert and take 9 damage. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious.
• You can't cast spells, and your ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of your beast form. Transforming doesn't break your concentration on a spell you've already cast, however, or prevent you from taking actions that are part of a spell, such as call lightning, that you've already cast.
• You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them if the new form is physically capable of doing so. However, you can't use any of your special senses, such as darkvision, unless your new form also has that sense.
• You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground in your space, merges into your new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal, but the DM decides whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change size or shape to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge with it. Equipment that merges with the form has no effect until you leave the form.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以選擇額外學習一項德魯伊戲法。
abilities.desc_en: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 2 級開始，你可以透過冥想和與大自然交流來恢復一些魔法能量。在短休期間，你可以選擇消耗的法術位來恢復。法術位的總等級可以等於或小於德魯伊等級的一半（無條件進位），並且沒有一個法術位可以達到 6 級或更高。在完成長休之前，你無法再次使用此特性

例如，當你是4級德魯伊時，你最多可以恢復兩級的法術位。你可以恢復一個2 環法術位或兩個1 環法術位。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest

For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to two levels worth of spell slots. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

abilities.desc_zh:
你與土地的神秘連結使你能施展特定法術。你會在德魯伊 3、5、7、9 級時，取得與加入結社時所在地形相關的結社法術。請選擇極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草原、山地、沼澤或幽暗地域，並查閱對應的法術表。

一旦取得一個結社法術，你便會始終準備該法術，且不計入每日可準備的法術數量。若該法術不在德魯伊法術表上，對你而言仍視為德魯伊法術。
abilities.desc_en:
Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land - arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or Underdark - and consult the associated list of spells.

Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

abilities.desc_zh:
你獲得在你的回合中使用野性變身的能力，作為附贈動作，而不是作為一個動作。

此外，當你被野性變身轉換時，你可以使用附贈動作消耗一個法術位，每消耗一級法術位就恢復 1d8 點生命值。
abilities.desc_en:
You gain the ability to use Wild Shape on your turn as a bonus action, rather than as an action.

Additionally, while you are transformed by Wild Shape, you can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

abilities.desc_zh:
你的圈子的儀式賦予你轉變成更危險的動物形態的能力。從第 2 級開始，你可以使用野性變身變身為挑戰等級高達 1 的野獸（你忽略野獸形狀表的最大 CR 列，但必須遵守那裡的其他限制）。

從 6 級開始，你可以變身為野獸，其挑戰等級等於你的德魯伊等級除以 3，無條件捨去。
abilities.desc_en:
The rites of your circle grant you the ability to transform into more dangerous animal forms. Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Wild Shape to transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1 (you ignore the Max. CR column of the Beast Shapes table, but must abide by the other limitations there).

Starting at 6th level, you can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as your druid level divided by 3, rounded down.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 4 級，你的野性變身會得到改善，如野獸形態表所示。
abilities.desc_en: At 4th level, your Wild Shape improves as shown on the Beast Shapes table.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 6 級開始，穿越非魔法的困難地形不需要額外的移動。你也可以穿過非魔法植物，而不會被它們減慢速度，如果它們有刺、刺或類似的危險，也不會受到它們的傷害。

此外，你在對抗那些透過魔法創造或操縱來阻礙移動的植物（例如由糾纏法術創造的植物）時具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 6 級開始，為了克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抵抗和免疫，你的野獸形態攻擊被視為魔法攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 8 級，你的野性變身會得到改善，如野獸形態表所示。
abilities.desc_en: At 8th level, your Wild Shape improves as shown on the Beast Shapes table.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你達到 10 級時，你不會被元素或精類迷惑或恐懼，並且你對毒藥和疾病免疫。
abilities.desc_en: When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

abilities.desc_zh: 10級時，你可以同時使用兩次野性變身來變身為風元素、土元素、火元素或水元素。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape at the same time to transform into an air elemental, an earth elemental, a fire elemental, or a water elemental.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你達到 14 級時，自然世界的生物會感覺到你與大自然的聯繫，並會猶豫是否要攻擊你。當野獸或植物生物攻擊你時，生物必須針對你的德魯伊法術豁免 DC 進行感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物必須選擇不同的目標，否則攻擊會自動失敗。豁免成功後，生物將在 24 小時內免疫此效果。

該生物在攻擊你之前就意識到了這種效果。
abilities.desc_en:
When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了 14 級，你已經學會了使用魔法以更微妙的方式改變你的身體形態。你可以隨意施放改變自我法術。
abilities.desc_en: By 14th level, you have learned to use magic to alter your physical form in more subtle ways. You can cast the alter self spell at will.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，你所使用的原始魔法會讓你老得更慢。每過去 10 年，你的身體僅衰老 1 年。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，你可以使用野性變身將許多德魯伊法術施展成你所呈現的任何形態。你可以在處於野獸形態時執行德魯伊法術的軀體和言語成分，但你無法提供物質成分。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

abilities.desc_zh:
20 級時，你可以無限次使用野性變身。

此外，你可以忽略德魯伊法術的語言和軀體成分，以及任何缺乏成本且不被法術消耗的材料成分。你可以在正常形態和野性變身的野獸形態中獲得這種好處。
abilities.desc_en:
At 20th level, you can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times.

Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shape from Wild Shape.

abilities.desc_zh: 選擇一種戰鬥風格；日後再次取得此特性時，不能重複選擇。
abilities.desc_en: Choose one fighting style. If you gain this feature again, you cannot choose the same style twice.

abilities.desc_zh: 使用遠程武器進行攻擊檢定時獲得 +2 加值。
abilities.desc_en: Gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged weapons.

abilities.desc_zh: 穿著護甲時，護甲等級 +1。
abilities.desc_en: While wearing armor, gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

abilities.desc_zh: 單手持用一把近戰武器，且另一手未持武器時，該武器的傷害擲骰獲得 +2 加值。
abilities.desc_en: When holding one melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 雙手持用近戰武器進行攻擊，傷害骰擲出 1 或 2 時，可重擲一次並必須採用新結果。武器必須具有雙手或兩用屬性。
abilities.desc_en: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a melee weapon held in two hands, reroll that die once and use the new result. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

abilities.desc_zh: 持有盾牌時，若可見生物攻擊你 5 呎內的其他目標，可使用反應使該次攻擊檢定具有劣勢。
abilities.desc_en: While wielding a shield, when a creature you can see attacks another target within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

abilities.desc_zh: 進行雙武器戰鬥時，可將能力調整值加到第二次攻擊的傷害。
abilities.desc_en: When fighting with two weapons, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 可用附贈動作恢復 1d10 + 戰士等級 點生命值。完成短休或長休後可再次使用。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. You regain this ability after a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 2 級開始，你可以暫時超越自己的正常極限。輪到你時，除了主要動作和可能的額外動作之外，你還可以採取額外動作。

一旦你使用此特性，你必須完成短休或長休才能再次使用它。從 17 級開始，你可以在休息前使用它兩次，但同一回合只能使用一次。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action.

Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 從你在第 3 級選擇此原型開始，你的武器攻擊在擲骰數為 19 或 20 時會獲得致命一擊。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 3 級，你可以熟練使用你選擇的一種工匠工具。
abilities.desc_en: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.
proficiency_tool_en: One type of artisan's tools of your choice

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在第三級選擇這個原型時，你會學習由稱為優勢骰子的特殊骰子所推動的動作。
abilities.desc_en: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called superiority dice.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以學習三種你選擇的動作，這些動作在下面的“動作”下列出。許多機動都以某種方式增強攻擊。每次攻擊只能使用一種動作。

你可以在第 7、10 和 15 級學習兩種你選擇的額外動作。每次學習新動作時，你都可以用不同的動作取代你所知道的一種動作。
abilities.desc_en:
You learn three maneuvers of your choice, which are listed under "Maneuvers" below. Many maneuvers enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one maneuver per attack.

You learn two additional maneuvers of your choice at 7th, 10th, and 15th level. Each time you learn new maneuvers, you can also replace one maneuver you know with a different one.

abilities.desc_zh:
你有四個優勢骰子，都是 d8。當你使用優勢骰子時，它會被消耗。當你完成短休或長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的優勢骰子。

你在 7 級時獲得另一個優勢骰子，在 15 級時又獲得一個優勢骰子。
abilities.desc_en:
You have four superiority dice, which are d8s. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain all of your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

You gain another superiority die at 7th level and one more at 15th level.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的一些動作需要你的目標進行一次豁免檢定來抵抗動作的效果。豁免DC計算如下：
abilities.desc_en: Some of your maneuvers require your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:

abilities.title_zh: 保存DC：8+熟練加值+力量和敏捷調整值
abilities.title_en: Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + str and dex modifier
abilities.desc_zh: 從以下選項中進行選擇：
abilities.desc_en: Choose from the following options:

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在回合中採取攻擊動作時，你可以放棄一次攻擊並使用附贈動作來指揮你的一個同伴進行攻擊。當你這樣做時，選擇一個可以看到或聽到你的友好生物並消耗一個優勢骰子。該生物可以立即使用其反應進行一次武器攻擊，將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中。
abilities.desc_en: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of your attacks and use a bonus action to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you and expend one superiority die. That creature can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack, adding the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試解除目標的武裝，迫使它掉落你選擇的一件它所持有的物品。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，並且目標必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。儲存失敗時，它會刪除你選擇的物件。該物體落在它的腳下。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to disarm the target, forcing it to drop one item of your choice that it's holding. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it drops the object you choose. The object lands at its feet.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來分散生物的注意力，為你的盟友提供一個空當。你將優勢骰子加入攻擊的傷害檢定。如果攻擊是在你的下一回合開始之前進行的，則除你之外的攻擊者對目標進行的下一次攻擊檢定具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to distract the creature, giving your allies an opening. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has advantage if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你移動時，你可以消耗一個優勢骰子，滾動骰子並將滾動的數字加到你的AC中，直到你停止移動。
abilities.desc_en: When you move, you can expend one superiority die, rolling the die and adding the number rolled to your AC until you stop moving.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以花費一個優勢骰子，並在你的回合中使用一個附贈動作進行佯攻，選擇一個距離你 5 呎以內的生物作為你的目標。你在本回合對抗該生物的下一次攻擊檢定中具有優勢。如果該攻擊命中，則將優勢骰子加到該攻擊的傷害檢定中。

如果在獲得優勢的回合中不使用該優勢，該優勢就會消失。
abilities.desc_en:
You can expend one superiority die and use a bonus action on your turn to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of you as your target. You have advantage on your next attack roll this turn against that creature. If that attack hits, add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

The advantage is lost if not used on the turn you gain it.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試刺激目標攻擊你。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害骰中，並且目標必須進行感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，則目標在對除你之外的目標的所有攻擊檢定中都處於劣勢，直到你的下一回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在你的回合進行近戰武器攻擊時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來增加你的攻擊範圍 5 呎。如果你擊中了，你就會將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中。
abilities.desc_en: When you make a melee weapon attack on your turn, you can expend one superiority die to increase your reach for that attack by 5 feet. If you hit, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來將你的一位戰友轉移到更有利的位置。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，然後選擇一個可以看到或聽到你的友方生物。該生物可以利用其反應將速度移動到其一半的速度，而不會引發你的攻擊目標的藉機攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to maneuver one of your comrades into a more advantageous position. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and you choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target of your attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試嚇唬目標。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害骰中，並且目標必須進行感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，它會害怕你，直到你的下一個回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to frighten the target. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 當另一個生物透過近戰攻擊對你造成傷害時，你可以使用你的反應並花費一個優勢骰子來減少傷害，減少的數值是你在優勢骰子上投出的數字+你的敏捷調整值。
abilities.desc_en: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction and expend one superiority die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your superiority die + your Dexterity modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你對一個生物進行武器攻擊檢定時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子將其加到檢定中。你可以在進行攻擊檢定之前或之後、但在攻擊的任何效果生效之前使用此機動。
abilities.desc_en: When you make a weapon attack roll against a creature, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the roll. You can use this maneuver before or after making the attack roll, but before any effects of the attack are applied.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試將目標擊退。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，如果目標較大或更小，則必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，你會將目標推到距離你 15 呎的地方。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to drive the target back. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you push the target up to 15 feet away from you.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用附贈動作並花費一個優勢骰子來增強你的一位同伴的決心。當你這樣做時，選擇一個可以看到或聽到你的友善生物。該生物獲得的臨時生命值等於優勢擲骰+你的魅力調整值。
abilities.desc_en: On your turn, you can use a bonus action and expend one superiority die to bolster the resolve of one of your companions. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature gains temporary hit points equal to the superiority die roll + your Charisma modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 當生物的近戰攻擊沒有擊中你時，你可以利用你的反應並花費一個優勢骰子來對該生物進行近戰武器攻擊。如果你擊中了，你就會將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中。
abilities.desc_en: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction and expend one superiority die to make a melee weapon attack against the creature. If you hit, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試用相同的攻擊傷害另一個生物。選擇在原始目標 5 呎以內且在你的攻擊範圍內的另一個生物。如果最初的攻擊檢定擊中了第二個生物，它所受到的傷害等於你在優勢骰子上檢定的數值。傷害與原始攻擊造成的傷害類型相同。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to damage another creature with the same attack. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your superiority die. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試擊倒目標。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，如果目標較大或更小，則必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，你會將目標擊倒。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to knock the target down. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you knock the target prone.

abilities.desc_zh: 智力是你施展巫師法術的能力，因為你透過學習和記憶來學習法術。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智力。此外，在為你施放的法師法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你會使用你的智力修正值。
abilities.desc_en: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells, since you learn your spells through study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 3 級，你學習一種儀式，在你和一件武器之間建立一種神奇的連結。整個儀式需要 1 小時，可以在短休期間完成。在整個儀式中，武器必須在你觸手可及的範圍內，儀式結束時，你觸摸武器並建立聯繫。

一旦你將武器與自己綁在一起，除非你喪失行為能力，否則你將無法解除該武器的武裝。如果它位於同一存在位面，你可以在你的回合中以附贈動作召喚該武器，使其立即傳送到你的手上。

你最多可以擁有兩把綁定武器，但透過附贈動作一次只能召喚一把。如果你嘗試與第三件武器建立聯繫，則必須打破與其他兩件武器之一的聯繫。
abilities.desc_en:
At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a short rest. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond.

Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you are incapacitated. If it is on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a bonus action on your turn, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand.

You can have up to two bonded weapons, but can summon only one at a time with your bonus action. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。

當你在這個職業中達到 11 級時，攻擊次數會增加到 3 次；當你在這個職業中達到 20 級時，攻擊次數會增加到 4 次。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 7 級開始，你可以將一半的熟練加值（無條件進位）加到你進行的任何尚未使用熟練加值的力量、敏捷或體質檢定中。

此外，当你进行奔跑跳远时，你可以移动的距离会增加等于你的力量调整值的呎数。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus.

In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 7 級，你可以選擇學習兩種額外的動作。
abilities.desc_en: At 7th level, you learn two additional maneuvers of your choice.

abilities.desc_zh: 你在第 7 級獲得另一個優勢骰子。
abilities.desc_en: You gain another superiority die at 7th level.

abilities.desc_zh:
如果你在戰鬥之外花至少 1 分鐘觀察或與另一個生物互動，你可以了解其與你自己的能力相比的某些資訊。 DM 會告訴你生物在你選擇的以下兩個特徵方面與你同等、優越或劣等：

• 力量得分
• 敏捷得分
• 體質分數
• 護甲等級
• 目前生命值
• 班級總水準（如果有）
• 戰鬥機等級（如果有）
abilities.desc_en:
If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice:

• Strength score
• Dexterity score
• Constitution score
• Armor Class
• Current hit points
• Total class levels (if any)
• Fighter class levels (if any)

abilities.desc_zh: 從 7 級開始，當你使用動作施展戲法時，你可以進行一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 7th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 9 級開始，你可以重投失敗的豁免檢定。如果這樣做，則必須使用新的骰子，並且在完成長休之前不能再次使用此特性。

從 13 級開始，你可以在長休息之間使用此特性兩次，從 17 級開始，在長休息之間可以使用該特性 3 次。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 10 級，你可以從戰鬥風格職業特性中選擇第二個選項。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 10 級，你可以選擇學習兩種額外的動作。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you learn two additional maneuvers of your choice.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 10 級，你的優勢骰子變成 d10。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, your superiority dice turn into d10s.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 10 級，你可以學習一個你選擇的額外巫師戲法。
abilities.desc_en: You learn an additional wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 10 級，你學會如何讓你的武器攻擊削弱生物對你法術的抵抗力。當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，該生物在下一次對抗你在下一個回合結束前施放的法術時會處於劣勢。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you learn how to make your weapon strikes undercut a creature's resistance to your spells. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 11級時，每當你在回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊3次。
abilities.desc_en: At 11th level, you can attack three times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 13 級，你可以在長休之間使用不屈兩次。
abilities.desc_en: At 13th level, you can use Indomitable twice between long rests.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 15 級開始，你的武器攻擊在擲骰中獲得致命一擊，擲骰數為 18-20。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 15 級，你可以選擇學習兩種額外的動作。
abilities.desc_en: At 15th level, you learn two additional maneuvers of your choice.

abilities.desc_zh: 你在第 15 級獲得另一個優勢骰子。
abilities.desc_en: You gain another superiority die at 15th level.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 15 級開始，當你投出主動權並且沒有剩餘優勢骰子時，你將重新獲得 1 個優勢骰子。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 15th level, when you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain 1 superiority die.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 15 級時，你可以傳送至 30 呎遠的未佔據空間，當你使用行動湧動時，你可以看到該空間。你可以在附加操作之前或之後傳送。
abilities.desc_en: At 15th level, you gain the ability to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see when you use your Action Surge. You can teleport before or after the additional action.

abilities.desc_zh: 17級時，你可以在休息前使用動作如潮兩次，但同一回合只能使用一次。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you can use Action Surge twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 17級時，你可以在長休之間使用不屈3次。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you can use Indomitable three times between long rests.

abilities.desc_zh: 18級時，你在戰鬥中達到了巔峰的韌性。在你的每個回合開始時，如果你剩餘的生命值不超過一半，你將恢復等於 5 + 你的體質調整值的生命值。如果你的生命值為 0，你就不會獲得此好處。
abilities.desc_en: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 18 級，你的優勢骰子變成 d12。
abilities.desc_en: At 18th level, your superiority dice turn into d12s.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，當你使用動作施展法術時，你可以進行一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 18th level, when you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

abilities.desc_zh: 在20級時，每當你在回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊四次。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, you can attack four times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 未穿著護甲且未持盾牌時，護甲等級為 10 + 敏捷調整值 + 感知調整值。
abilities.desc_en: While not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

abilities.desc_zh:
未穿著護甲、未持盾牌，且僅空手或持用武僧武器時：

• 可用敏捷取代力量進行空手與武僧武器的攻擊及傷害擲骰
• 可用 d4 取代空手與武僧武器的原始傷害骰；此骰會隨等級提高
• 在攻擊動作中使用空手或武僧武器後，可用附贈動作再進行一次空手攻擊

武僧武器包括短劍，以及不具雙手或重型屬性的簡易近戰武器。
abilities.desc_en:
While unarmored, not wielding a shield, and using only unarmed strikes or monk weapons:

• You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and monk weapons
• You can use a d4 in place of the normal damage die for unarmed strikes and monk weapons; this die increases with level
• After using an unarmed strike or monk weapon as part of the Attack action, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action

Monk weapons are shortswords and simple melee weapons without the two-handed or heavy property.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第二級開始，你的訓練可以讓你利用氣的神秘能量。你對這種能量的獲取由 ki 點的數量表示。你的武僧等級決定了你擁有的點數，如武僧表的 Ki 點數 列所示。

你可以使用這些積分來增強各種 ki 特性。你開始了解三個這樣的特性：連擊、耐心防禦和飛簷走壁。當你在本課程中獲得等級時，你會學到更多的 ki 特性。

當你消耗氣點時，只有在完成短休或長休後才能使用，休息結束後，你將所有消耗的氣重新吸回體內。剩下的時間你必須花至少 30 分鐘冥想才能恢復你的氣點。

你的一些氣特性要求你的目標進行一次豁免檢定來抵抗該特性的效果。豁免DC計算如下：
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. Your access to this energy is represented by a number of ki points. Your monk level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Monk table.

You can spend these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing three such features: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. You learn more ki features as you gain levels in this class.

When you spend a ki point, it is unavailable until you finish a short or long rest, at the end of which you draw all of your expended ki back into yourself. You must spend at least 30 minutes of the rest meditating to regain your ki points.

Some of your ki features require your target to make a saving throw to resist the feature's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中採取攻擊行動後，你可以立即花費 1 點氣進行兩次徒手攻擊作為附贈動作。
abilities.desc_en: Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以花費 1 點氣來採取閃避動作，作為你回合的附贈動作。
abilities.desc_en: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以花費 1 點氣來採取脫離或衝刺動作作為你回合的附贈動作，並且你的跳躍距離在該回合加倍。
abilities.desc_en: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 2 級開始，當你不穿著盔甲或揮舞盾牌時，你的速度會增加 10 呎。當你達到一定的武僧等級時，此加值會增加，如武僧表中所示。

在第 9 級，你能夠在輪流中沿著垂直表面移動並穿過液體，而不會在移動過程中跌倒。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 2nd level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain monk levels, as shown in the Monk table.

At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 3 級開始，當你被遠程武器攻擊擊中時，你可以利用你的反應來偏轉或捕獲導彈。當你這樣做時，你受到的攻擊傷害會減少 1d10 + 你的敏捷調整值 + 你的武僧等級。

如果將傷害降低到 0，並且導彈足夠小，可以用一隻手握住，並且你至少有一隻手空閒，那麼你就可以抓住導彈。如果你以這種方式捕獲導彈，你可以花費 1 ki 點使用你剛剛捕獲的武器或彈藥進行遠程攻擊（範圍 20/60 呎），作為同一反應的一部分。無論你的武器熟練程度如何，你都會熟練地進行這次攻擊，並且導彈算作這次攻擊的武僧武器。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 3rd level, you can use your reaction to deflect or catch the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level.

If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile if it is small enough for you to hold in one hand and you have at least one hand free. If you catch a missile in this way, you can spend 1 ki point to make a ranged attack (range 20/60 feet) with the weapon or piece of ammunition you just caught, as part of the same reaction. You make this attack with proficiency, regardless of your weapon proficiencies, and the missile counts as a monk weapon for the attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 4 級開始，你可以在跌倒時使用你的反應來減少你受到的跌倒傷害，傷害值相當於你武僧等級的五倍。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 4th level, you can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，你可以乾擾對手體內的氣流。當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中另一個生物時，你可以花費 1 點氣來嘗試一次驚人的攻擊。目標必須成功通過體質豁免，否則將被眩暈直到你的下一個回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 5th level, you can interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 從等級 6 開始，為了克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抵抗和免疫，你的徒手攻擊算作魔法攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 6th level, your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 7 級時，你本能的敏捷性可以讓你躲避某些區域效果，例如藍龍的閃電吐息或火球術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。
abilities.desc_en: At 7th level, your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a blue dragon's lightning breath or a fireball spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 7 級開始，你可以用你的行動來結束對你自己造成的一種導致你被魅惑或恐懼的效果。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 7th level, you can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 9 級，你能夠在輪流中沿著垂直表面移動並穿過液體，而不會在移動過程中跌倒。
abilities.desc_en: At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

abilities.desc_zh: 10級時，你對流經體內的氣的掌握使你免疫疾病和毒藥。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, your mastery of the ki flowing through you makes you immune to disease and poison.

abilities.title_en: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
abilities.desc_zh: 從第 13 級開始，你學習接觸他人心靈的“氣”，以便理解所有口語。此外，任何能夠理解語言的生物都可以理解你所說的話。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 13th level, you learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 14 級開始，你對氣的掌握使你精通所有豁免檢定。

此外，每當你進行豁免檢定並失敗時，你可以花費 1 點氣重新投擲並獲得第二個結果。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 14th level, your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws.

Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.
