abilities.desc_zh: 在15級時，你的氣會支撐你，這樣你就不會遭受年老時的虛弱之苦，而且你也不會神奇地變老。然而，你仍然可能因年老而死亡。此外，你不再需要食物或水。
abilities.desc_en: At 15th level, your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged magically. You can still die of old age, however. In addition, you no longer need food or water.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 18 級開始，你可以用你的行動花費 4 點氣來隱形 1 分鐘。在此期間，你還可以抵抗除力力傷害之外的所有傷害。

此外，你可以花費8點氣來施放星體投射法術，而不需要材料成分。當你這樣做時，你不能帶走任何其他生物。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 18th level, you can use your action to spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you also have resistance to all damage but force damage.

Additionally, you can spend 8 ki points to cast the astral projection spell, without needing material components. When you do so, you can't take any other creatures with you.

abilities.desc_zh: 在20級，當你投出主動權並且沒有剩餘氣點時，你會恢復4點氣。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, when you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.

abilities.desc_zh: 使用動作後，直到下回合結束前，你會知道 60 呎內未受全身掩蔽的天界生物、邪魔與不死生物的位置及類型，但無法得知個體身分。你也能感知範圍內受聖化或褻瀆的地點或物品。每次長休前可使用 1 + 魅力調整值 次，至少一次。
abilities.desc_en: As an action, until the end of your next turn, you know the location and type of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover, but not its identity. You also detect consecrated or desecrated places or objects in range. You can use this feature 1 + Charisma modifier times per long rest, with a minimum of once.

abilities.desc_zh: 你擁有等於 聖騎士等級 × 5 的治療池。可用動作觸碰生物並消耗池中點數，恢復等量生命值；也可消耗 5 點治癒一種疾病或中和一種毒素。此能力對不死生物與構裝生物無效，完成長休後恢復治療池。
abilities.desc_en: You have a healing pool equal to paladin level × 5. As an action, touch a creature and spend points from the pool to restore that many hit points. You can instead spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. This feature has no effect on undead or constructs, and the pool replenishes after a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 2 級開始，當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中生物時，除了武器傷害之外，你還可以花費一個法術位對目標造成光輝傷害。 1級法術位的額外傷害為2d8，每高於1級的法術位額外傷害1d8，最多為5d8。如果目標是不死族或惡魔，則傷害增加 1d8。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

abilities.desc_zh:
你採用特定的戰鬥風格作為你的專長。從選用特性清單中選擇一種戰鬥風格。即使你可以再次選擇，你也不能多次選擇相同的戰鬥風格選項。

選擇以下選項之一：
abilities.desc_en:
You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose a fighting style from the list of optional features. You can't take the same Fighting Style option more than once, even if you get to choose again.

Choose one of the following:

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在敵對生物 5 呎範圍內進行遠程攻擊時，你在攻擊檢定上不會處於劣勢。你的遠程攻擊會忽略對你 30 呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊時的攻擊檢定有+1加值。
abilities.desc_en: When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你穿著盔甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。
abilities.desc_en: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你一手揮舞近戰武器而沒有其他武器時，你使用該武器的傷害檢定獲得+2加值。
abilities.desc_en: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你使用兩隻手揮舞的近戰武器進行攻擊時，在傷害骰子上擲出 1 或 2 時，你可以重新擲骰子，並且必須使用新的骰子。該武器必須具有雙手或多用途屬性才能獲得此好處。
abilities.desc_en: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

abilities.desc_zh: 只要你沒有穿著重甲或使用盾牌，你的游泳速度和攀爬速度就等於你的正常速度，而且你的AC獲得+1加值。
abilities.desc_en: As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你能看到的生物攻擊距離你 5 呎內除你之外的目標時，你可以利用你的反應對攻擊檢定施加不利影響。你一定拿著盾牌。
abilities.desc_en: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為附贈動作，你可以進入防禦姿態，持續到你的下一個回合開始。當處於防禦姿態時，你可以在不使用反應的情況下進行藉機攻擊，並且可以使用你的反應對在你的攻擊範圍內移動超過 5 呎的生物進行近戰攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

abilities.desc_zh:
聖騎士表格顯示了你必須施展法術的法術位數量。要施展你的一個 1 級或更高等級的聖騎士法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的一個槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

你準備可供你施展的聖騎士法術表，從聖騎士法術表中進行選擇。當你這樣做時，選擇一定數量的聖騎士法術，數量等於你的魅力調整值+你的聖騎士等級的一半，無條件捨去（至少一個法術）。這些法術必須屬於你有法術位的等級。

例如，如果你是 5 級聖騎士，則你有 4 個 1 級法術位和 2 個 2 級法術位。當魅力為 14 時，你準備的法術表可以包括 4 個 1 級或 2 級法術的任意組合。如果你準備了 1 級法術來治療傷口，則可以使用 1 級或 2 級插槽來施放它。施展該法術並不會將其從你準備好的法術表中刪除。

當你完成長休後，你可以改變你準備好的法術表。準備一份新的聖騎士法術表需要花費時間進行祈禱和冥想：清單中的每個法術每個法術等級至少需要 1 分鐘。
abilities.desc_en:
The Paladin table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells. To cast one of your paladin spells of 1st level or higher, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

You prepare the list of paladin spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the paladin spell list. When you do so, choose a number of paladin spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level, rounded down (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

For example, if you are a 5th-level paladin, you have four 1st-level and two 2nd-level spell slots. With a Charisma of 14, your list of prepared spells can include four spells of 1st or 2nd-level, in any combination. If you prepare the 1st-level spell cure wounds, you can cast it using a 1st-level or a 2nd-level slot. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.

You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of paladin spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.

abilities.desc_zh: 魅力是你對聖騎士法術的施法能力，因為它們的力量源自於你堅定的信念。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的魅力。此外，在為你施放的聖騎士法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的魅力調整值。
abilities.desc_en: Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your paladin spells, since their power derives from the strength of your convictions. You use your Charisma whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Charisma modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a paladin spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用聖徽作為聖騎士法術的施法焦點。
abilities.desc_en: You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus for your paladin spells.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了第三級，流經你體內的神聖魔法使你對疾病免疫。
abilities.desc_en: By 3rd level, the divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

abilities.desc_zh:
每個誓言都有一個相關法術表。你可以在誓言描述中指定的等級使用這些法術。一旦你獲得了誓言法術，你就必須做好準備。誓言法術不計入你每天可以準備的法術數量。

如果你獲得的誓言法術沒有出現在聖騎士法術表中，那麼法術仍然是適合你的聖騎士法術。
abilities.desc_en:
Each oath has a list of associated spells. You gain access to these spells at the leves specified in the oath description. Once you gain access to an oath spell, you always have it prepared. Oath spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

If you gain an oath spell that doesn't appear on the paladin spell list, the spell is nonetheless a paladin spell for you.

abilities.desc_zh:
聖騎士努力遵守最高的行為標準，但即使是最有道德的聖騎士也難免犯錯。有時，正確的道路要求太高，有時，情況需要兩害相權取其輕，有時，情緒的熾熱會導致聖騎士違背他或她的誓言。

違背誓言的聖騎士通常會尋求與他或她有共同信仰的牧師或同階聖騎士的赦免。聖騎士可能會整夜守夜祈禱，以示懺悔，或採取快速或類似的自我否定行為。在懺悔和寬恕的儀式之後，聖騎士重新開始。

如果聖騎士故意違背自己的誓言並且沒有任何悔改的跡象，那麼後果可能會更加嚴重。根據 DM 的判斷，不知悔改的聖騎士可能會被迫放棄這個職業並採用另一個職業，或者可能選擇《地下城主指南》中出現的破誓者聖騎士選項。
abilities.desc_en:
A paladin tries to hold to the highest standards of conduct, but even the most virtuous paladin is fallible. Sometimes the right path proves too demanding, sometimes a situation calls for the lesser of two evils, and sometimes the heat of emotion causes a paladin to transgress his or her oath.

A paladin who has broken a vow typically seeks absolution from a cleric who shares his or her faith or from another paladin of the same order. The paladin might spend an all-night vigil in prayer as a sign of penitence, or undertake a fast or similar act of self-denial. After a rite of confession and forgiveness, the paladin starts fresh.

If a paladin willfully violates his or her oath and shows no sign of repentance, the consequences can be more serious. At the DM's discretion, an impenitent paladin might be forced to abandon this class and adopt another, or perhaps to take the Oathbreaker paladin option that appears in the Dungeon Master's Guide.

abilities.desc_zh: 上古誓言的信條已經被保存了無數個世紀。這個誓言強調善良的原則高於任何法律或混亂的擔憂。它的四個核心原則很簡單。
abilities.desc_en: The tenets of the Oath of the Ancients have been preserved for uncounted centuries. This oath emphasizes the principles of good above any concerns of law or chaos. Its four central principles are simple.

abilities.desc_zh: 透過你的仁慈、仁慈和寬恕的行為，點燃世界的希望之光，擊退絕望。
abilities.desc_en: Through your acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair.

abilities.desc_zh: 世界上哪裡有善、美、愛和歡笑，哪裡就有吞噬它們的惡。在生命繁榮的地方，要對抗那些使它變得貧瘠的力量。
abilities.desc_en: Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren.

abilities.desc_zh: 享受歌聲和笑聲、美麗和藝術。如果你讓自己心中的光熄滅，你就無法將它保存在世界上。
abilities.desc_en: Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can't preserve it in the world.

abilities.desc_zh: 成為所有生活在絕望中的人的光榮燈塔。讓你的喜悅和勇氣之光在你的所有行為中閃耀。
abilities.desc_en: Be a glorious beacon for all who live in despair. Let the light of your joy and courage shine forth in all your deeds.

abilities.desc_zh:
你在列出的聖武士等級中獲得誓言法術。

|聖騎士等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第三 |誘捕打擊，與動物對話|
|第五 |月光，迷濛步|
|9日 |植物生長，免受能量影響|
| 13日 |冰風暴，石膚|
| 17日 |與大自然交流，樹大步走|
abilities.desc_en:
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3rd | ensnaring strike, speak with animals |
| 5th | moonbeam, misty step |
| 9th | plant growth, protection from energy |
| 13th | ice storm, stoneskin |
| 17th | commune with nature, tree stride |

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用你的通道神性來召喚原始力量來誘捕敵人。作為一個動作，你可以使幽靈藤蔓彈出並到達你能看到的 10 呎範圍內的生物。該生物必須成功通過力量或敏捷豁免檢定（由其選擇），否則就會被束縛。當被藤蔓束縛時，該生物會在每個回合結束時重複豁免檢定。一旦成功，它就會釋放自己，藤蔓就會消失。
abilities.desc_en: You can use your Channel Divinity to invoke primeval forces to ensnare a foe. As an action, you can cause spectral vines to spring up and reach for a creature within 10 feet of you that you can see. The creature must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or be restrained. While restrained by the vines, the creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it frees itself and the vines vanish.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以使用你的神性通道說出讓精類和惡魔聽到會感到痛苦的古老話語。作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽，距離你 30 呎內的每一個能聽到你聲音的精類或惡魔都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，該生物會翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。

如果該生物的真實形態被幻象、變形或其他效果隱藏，那麼該生物的形態會在其轉身時顯露出來。
abilities.desc_en:
You can use your Channel Divinity to utter ancient words that are painful for fey and fiends to hear. As an action, you present your holy symbol, and each fey or fiend within 30 feet of you that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

If the creature's true form is concealed by an illusion, shapeshifting, or other effect, that form is revealed while it is turned.

abilities.desc_zh: 儘管忠誠誓言的確切用詞和限制各不相同，但該誓言的聖武士們都遵循這些原則。
abilities.desc_en: Though the exact words and strictures of the Oath of Devotion vary, paladins of this oath share these tenets.

abilities.desc_zh: 不要說謊或欺騙。讓你的話成為你的承諾。
abilities.desc_en: Don't lie or cheat. Let your word be your promise.

abilities.desc_zh: 永遠不要害怕採取行動，儘管謹慎是明智的。
abilities.desc_en: Never fear to act, though caution is wise.

abilities.desc_zh: 幫助他人，保護弱者，懲罰威脅他們的人。對你的敵人表現出憐憫，但要用智慧來緩和它。
abilities.desc_en: Aid others, protect the weak, and punish those who threaten them. Show mercy to your foes, but temper it with wisdom.

abilities.desc_zh: 公平對待他人，讓你的光榮行為成為他人的榜樣。盡可能多行善，同時造成最少的傷害。
abilities.desc_en: Treat others with fairness, and let your honorable deeds be an example to them. Do as much good as possible while causing the least amount of harm.

abilities.desc_zh: 對你的行為及其後果負責，保護那些託付給你照顧的人，並服從那些對你有公正權威的人。
abilities.desc_en: Be responsible for your actions and their consequences, protect those entrusted to your care, and obey those who have just authority over you.

abilities.desc_zh:
你在列出的聖武士等級中獲得誓言法術。

|聖騎士等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第三 |免受邪惡和善良的保護，庇護所|
|第五 |較小的恢復，真理區|
| 9日 |希望的燈塔，驅散魔法|
| 13日 |行動自由，信仰守護者|
| 17日 |公社，火焰襲擊|
abilities.desc_en:
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3rd | protection from evil and good, sanctuary |
| 5th | lesser restoration, zone of truth |
| 9th | beacon of hope, dispel magic |
| 13th | freedom of movement, guardian of faith |
| 17th | commune, flame strike |

abilities.desc_zh:
作為一個動作，你可以使用你的神性通道為你所持有的一件武器注入正能量。在 1 分鐘內，你將你的魅力調整值加到使用該武器進行的攻擊檢定中（最低加值+1）。該武器還在 20 呎半徑內發出明亮的光線，並在半徑 20 呎之外發出昏暗的光線。如果該武器尚未具有魔法，則會在持續時間內變得具有魔法。

作為任何其他行動的一部分，你可以在你的回合結束此效果。如果你不再持有或攜帶該武器，或者你失去知覺，效果就會結束。
abilities.desc_en:
As an action, you can imbue one weapon that you are holding with positive energy, using your Channel Divinity. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (with a minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. If the weapon is not already magical, it becomes magical for the duration.

You can end this effect on your turn as part of any other action. If you are no longer holding or carrying this weapon, or if you fall unconscious, this effect ends.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽，並使用你的通道神性進行譴責惡魔和不死生物的祈禱。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到或聽到你的惡魔或不死生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它將被翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。
abilities.desc_en:
As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring fiends and undead, using your Channel Divinity. Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

abilities.desc_zh: 復仇誓言的信條因聖武士而異，但所有信條都圍繞著以任何必要手段懲罰不法之徒。秉持這些信條的聖武士甚至願意犧牲自己的正義來為那些作惡的人伸張正義，因此聖武士通常是中立或守序中立的陣營。這些原則的核心原則非常簡單。
abilities.desc_en: The tenets of the Oath of Vengeance vary by paladin, but all the tenets revolve around punishing wrongdoers by any means necessary. Paladins who uphold these tenets are willing to sacrifice even their own righteousness to mete out justice upon those who do evil, so the paladins are often neutral or lawful neutral in alignment. The core principles of the tenets are brutally simple.

abilities.desc_zh:
面臨著與我的死敵戰鬥或與較小的邪惡戰鬥的選擇。我選擇更大的邪惡。

對惡人毫不憐憫

普通的敵人可能會贏得我的憐憫，但我的不共戴天的敵人卻不會。

採取任何必要的手段

我的疑慮無法阻止我消滅敵人。
abilities.desc_en:
Faced with a choice of fighting my sworn foes or combating a lesser evil. I choose the greater evil.

No Mercy for the Wicked

Ordinary foes might win my mercy, but my sworn enemies do not.

By Any Means Necessary

My qualms can't get in the way of exterminating my foes.

abilities.desc_zh: 如果我的敵人毀滅了世界，那是因為我沒能阻止他們。我必須幫助那些因自己的不當行為而受到傷害的人。
abilities.desc_en: If my foes wreak ruin on the world, it is because I failed to stop them. I must help those harmed by their misdeeds.

abilities.desc_zh:
你在列出的聖武士等級中獲得誓言法術。

|聖騎士等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第三 |禍根，獵人標記|
|第五 |牽人，飄渺步|
|9日 |匆忙，能量防護|
| 13日 |放逐，次元門|
| 17日 |抓住怪物，探知|
abilities.desc_en:
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3rd | bane, hunter's mark |
| 5th | hold person, misty step |
| 9th | haste, protection from energy |
| 13th | banishment, dimension door |
| 17th | hold monster, scrying |

abilities.desc_zh:
作為一個行動，你展示你的聖徽，並使用你的通道神性說出譴責的祈禱。選擇一個距離你 60 呎內你能看到的生物。該生物必須進行感知豁免檢定，除非它免疫恐懼。惡魔和不死生物在此豁免檢定上處於劣勢。

如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到恐懼 1 分鐘或直到任何傷害。當受到驚嚇時，該生物的速度為 0，並且無法獲得任何速度加成。

豁免成功後，生物的速度減半 1 分鐘或直到生物受到任何傷害。
abilities.desc_en:
As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer of denunciation, using your Channel Divinity. Choose one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw, unless it is immune to being frightened. Fiends and undead have disadvantage on this saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While frightened, the creature's speed is 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.

On a successful save, the creature's speed is halved for 1 minute or until the creature takes any damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為附贈動作，你可以使用你的引導神性，對你在 10 呎內看到的生物發出敵意誓言。你在對抗該生物的攻擊檢定上獲得優勢，持續 1 分鐘或直到其生命值降至 0 或失去知覺。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you can utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 10 feet of you, using your Channel Divinity. You gain advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 6 級開始，每當你或你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物必須進行豁免檢定時，該生物將在豁免檢定上獲得等於你的魅力調整值的加值（加值最低為+1）。你必須有意識地授予此額外。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 6th level, whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (with a minimum bonus of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 7 級開始，遠古魔法對你的影響如此之大，以至於形成了一個可怕的結界。你和你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物對法術傷害具有抵抗力。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 7th level, ancient magic lies so heavily upon you that it forms an eldritch ward. You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to damage from spells.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 7 級開始，當你有意識時，你和你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物無法被魅惑。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了 7 級，你的超自然專注可以幫助你封鎖敵人的退路。當你藉機攻擊擊中生物時，你可以在攻擊後立即將速度提高一半，並且作為同一反應的一部分。此移動不會引發藉機攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: By 7th level, your supernatural focus helps you close off a foe's retreat. When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 10 級開始，當你有意識時，你和你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物不會被嚇到。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了11級，你已經充滿了正義的力量，你所有的近戰武器攻擊都帶有神聖的力量。每當你用近戰武器擊中生物時，生物會受到額外的 1d8 光輝傷害。如果你在攻擊中還使用了神聖重擊，則將此傷害添加到神聖重擊的額外傷害中。
abilities.desc_en: By 11th level, you are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry divine power with them. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage. If you also use your Divine Smite with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Divine Smite.

abilities.desc_zh:
從14級開始，你可以用你的動作結束對你自己或你觸摸的一個自願生物的一個法術。

你可以使用此特性的次數等於你的魅力調整值（至少一次）。當你完成長休後，你將恢復已消耗的用途。
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
從15級開始，當你的生命值降低到0並且沒有被直接殺死時，你可以選擇將生命值降低到1。一旦你使用了這個能力，你就不能再使用它，直到你完成長休。

此外，你不會遭受年老帶來的任何弊端，也不會神奇地變老。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 15th level, when you are reduced to 0 hit points and are not killed outright, you can choose to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Additionally, you suffer none of the drawbacks of old age, and you can't be aged magically.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 15 級開始，你始終受到邪惡和善良法術的保護。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 15th level, you are always under the effects of a protection from evil and good spell.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 15 級開始，你說出敵意誓言的權威賦予你對敵人更大的力量。當受到你的敵意誓言影響的生物進行攻擊時，如果該生物在攻擊範圍內，你可以使用你的反應對該生物進行近戰武器攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 15th level, the authority with which you speak your Vow of Enmity gives you greater power over your foe. When a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature if it is within range.

abilities.desc_zh: 18 級時，你的防護光環範圍增加至 30 呎。
abilities.desc_en: At 18th level, the range of your Aura of Protection increases to 30 feet.

abilities.desc_zh:
在20級時，你可以呈現出一種古老的自然力量的形態，呈現出你選擇的外觀。例如，你的皮膚可能會變綠或呈現樹皮狀紋理，你的頭髮可能會變得綠葉狀或苔蘚狀，或者你可能會長出鹿角或獅子狀的鬃毛。

透過你的行動，你會經歷轉變。 1 分鐘，你將獲得以下好處：

• 在你的每個回合開始時，你會恢復 10 點生命值。
• 每當你施放一個施法時間為1個動作的聖騎士法術時，你可以使用你的附贈動作來施放它。
• 距離你 10 呎內的敵方生物在對抗你的聖武士法術和引導神力選項的豁免檢定中處於劣勢。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。
abilities.desc_en:
At 20th level, you can assume the form of an ancient force of nature, taking on an appearance you choose. For example, your skin might turn green or take on a bark-like texture, your hair might become leafy or mosslike, or you might sprout antlers or a lion-like mane.

Using your action, you undergo a transformation. For 1 minute, you gain the following benefits:

• At the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 hit points.
• Whenever you cast a paladin spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can cast it using your bonus action instead.
• Enemy creatures within 10 feet of you have disadvantage on saving throws against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity options.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
20級時，作為一個動作，你可以散發出陽光的光環。在 1 分鐘內，明亮的光線會照射到你周圍 30 呎的半徑範圍內，而昏暗的光線則會照射到半徑 30 呎以外的地方。

每當敵方生物在強光下開始回合時，該生物就會受到 10 點光輝傷害。

此外，在持續時間內，你在對抗惡魔或不死生物施展的法術時擁有豁免檢定優勢。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。
abilities.desc_en:
At 20th level, as an action, you can emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that.

Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant damage.

In addition, for the duration, you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
20級時，你可以化身為天使復仇者。透過你的行動，你會經歷轉變。 1小時內，你可以獲得以下好處：

• 翅膀從你的背後長出，賦予你60呎的飛行速度。
• 你在30呎半徑範圍內散發出威脅的氣息。當任何敵方生物第一次進入光環或在戰鬥中開始其回合時，該生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則就會對你感到恐懼，持續 1 分鐘或直到它受到任何傷害。對受驚生物的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。
abilities.desc_en:
At 20th level, you can assume the form of an angelic avenger. Using your action, you undergo a transformation. For 1 hour, you gain the following benefits:

• Wings sprout from your back and grant you a flying speed of 60 feet.
• You emanate an aura of menace in a 30-foot radius. The first time any enemy creature enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. Attack rolls against the frightened creature have advantage.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
選擇一類宿敵：異怪、野獸、天界生物、構裝生物、龍、元素生物、精類、邪魔、巨人、怪獸、泥怪、植物或不死生物；也可改選兩類類人生物。

追蹤宿敵的感知（生存）檢定，以及回想其相關資訊的智力檢定具有優勢。若宿敵會說話，還可學會其使用的一種語言。
abilities.desc_en:
Choose one favored enemy type: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Alternatively, choose two types of humanoids.

You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track favored enemies and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. If your favored enemies speak a language, you also learn one language they use.
proficiency_lan_en: One language used by the favored enemy

abilities.desc_zh:
選擇一種偏好地形：極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草原、山地、沼澤或幽暗地域。進行與該地形有關的智力或感知檢定時，若使用熟練技能，熟練加值加倍。

在偏好地形旅行一小時以上時：

• 困難地形不會減緩團隊的旅行速度
• 除非受到魔法影響，團隊不會迷路
• 即使從事覓食、導航或追蹤等其他活動，仍會對危險保持警戒
• 獨自行動時，可用正常速度隱匿移動
• 覓食時可找到兩倍食物
• 追蹤生物時，可得知其確切數量、體型，以及經過此處多久
abilities.desc_en:
Choose one favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the Underdark. On Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to that terrain, double your proficiency bonus if you use a proficient skill.

When traveling through favored terrain for at least 1 hour:

• Difficult terrain does not slow your group's travel
• Your group cannot become lost except by magical means
• You remain alert to danger while performing another activity, such as foraging, navigating, or tracking
• When traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace
• You find twice as much food while foraging
• While tracking, you learn the creatures' exact number, sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area

abilities.desc_zh:
在第二級，你將採用一種特定的戰鬥風格作為你的專長。選擇以下選項之一：射箭、防禦、決鬥、水手或雙武器格鬥。即使你稍後可以再次選擇，你也不能多次選擇戰鬥風格選項。

選擇以下選項之一：
abilities.desc_en:
At 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options: Archery, Defense, Dueling, Mariner, or Two-Weapon Fighting. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

Choose one of the following:

abilities.desc_zh: 你使用遠程武器進行的攻擊檢定獲得+2加值。
abilities.desc_en: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你在敵對生物 5 呎範圍內進行遠程攻擊時，你在攻擊檢定上不會處於劣勢。你的遠程攻擊會忽略對你 30 呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊時的攻擊檢定有+1加值。
abilities.desc_en: When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你穿著盔甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。
abilities.desc_en: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你一手揮舞近戰武器而沒有其他武器時，你使用該武器的傷害檢定獲得+2加值。
abilities.desc_en: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 只要你沒有穿著重甲或使用盾牌，你的游泳速度和攀爬速度就等於你的正常速度，而且你的AC獲得+1加值。
abilities.desc_en: As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為附贈動作，你可以進入防禦姿態，持續到你的下一個回合開始。當處於防禦姿態時，你可以在不使用反應的情況下進行藉機攻擊，並且可以使用你的反應對在你的攻擊範圍內移動超過 5 呎的生物進行近戰攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你進行雙武器戰鬥時，你可以將你的能力調整值加到第二次攻擊的傷害上。
abilities.desc_en: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 智慧是你對遊俠法術的施法能力，因為你的魔法依賴你對大自然的協調。每當法術涉及到你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智慧。此外，在為你施放的遊俠法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用遊俠法術進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的感知調整值。
abilities.desc_en: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your ranger spells, since your magic draws on your attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a ranger spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 3 級開始，你可以使用你的動作並消耗一個遊俠法術位來將你的意識集中在你周圍的區域。在你花費的每級法術位1分鐘內，你可以感知以下類型的生物是否存在於你的1英里範圍內（如果你在你喜歡的地形中，則在最多6英里範圍內）：異獸、天體、龍、元素、精類、惡魔和不死生物。此特性不會透露生物的位置或數量。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 3rd level, you can use your action and expend one ranger spell slot to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the spell slot you expend, you can sense whether the following types of creatures are present within 1 mile of you (or within up to 6 miles if you are in your favored terrain): aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. This feature doesn't reveal the creatures' location or number.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 3 級，你可以選擇以下特性之一：巨像殺手、巨人殺手或部落破壞者。
abilities.desc_en: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的堅韌可以打敗最強大的敵人。當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，如果生物的生命值低於其最大生命值，則該生物會受到額外的 1d8 點傷害。你每回合只能造成一次額外傷害。
abilities.desc_en: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你 5 呎內的大型或更大的生物攻擊擊中或錯過你時，你可以在攻擊後立即使用你的反應來攻擊該生物，前提是你可以看到生物。
abilities.desc_en: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你進行武器攻擊的每個回合中，你可以使用相同的武器對原始目標 5 呎內且在你的武器射程內的不同生物進行另一次攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

abilities.desc_zh:
你將獲得一個野獸夥伴，它會陪伴你冒險，並接受訓練與你並肩作戰。選擇不大於中型且挑戰等級為 1/4 或更低的野獸。將你的熟練加值加到野獸的AC、攻擊檢定和傷害檢定上，以及它擅長的任何豁免檢定和技能上。它的最大生命值等於它的正常最大生命值或你的遊俠等級的四倍，以較高者為準。

野獸會盡可能地服從你的命令。它會根據你的主動性採取行動，但除非你命令它，否則它不會採取任何行動。輪到你的時候，你可以口頭命令野獸移動到哪裡（不需要你採取任何行動）。你可以使用你的動作口頭命令它採取攻擊、衝刺、脫離、閃避或幫助動作。一旦你擁有額外攻擊特性，當你命令野獸採取攻擊行動時，你可以自己進行一次武器攻擊。

如果你喪失行為能力或缺席，你的野獸夥伴會自行行動，專注於保護你和它自己。它從來不需要你的命令來使用它的反應，例如在進行藉機攻擊時。

與任何生物一樣，野獸可以在短休期間消耗生命骰子。

當只與野獸一起穿越你喜歡的地形時，你可以以正常的速度悄悄移動。

如果該野獸死亡，你可以通過花費 8 小時與另一隻對你沒有敵意的野獸（無論是與之前相同類型的野獸還是不同類型的野獸）神奇地結合來獲得另一隻野獸。
abilities.desc_en:
You gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and is trained to fight alongside you. Choose a beast that is no larger than Medium and that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower. Add your proficiency bonus to the beast's AC, attack rolls, and damage rolls, as well as to any saving throws and skills it is proficient in. Its hit point maximum equals its normal maximum or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher.

The beast obeys your commands as best as it can. It takes its turn on your initiative, though it doesn't take an action unless you command it to. On your turn, you can verbally command the beast where to move (no action required by you). You can use your action to verbally command it to take the Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action. Once you have the Extra Attack feature, you can make one weapon attack yourself when you command the beast to take the Attack action.

If you are incapacitated or absent, your beast companion acts on its own, focusing on protecting you and itself. It never requires your command to use its reaction, such as when making an opportunity attack.

Like any creature, the beast can spend hit dice during a short rest.

While traveling through your favored terrain with only the beast, you can move stealthily at a normal pace.

If the beast dies, you can obtain another one by spending 8 hours magically bonding with another beast that isn't hostile to you, either the same type of beast as before or a different one.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.title_zh: 宿敵和自然探險家的改進
abilities.title_en: Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements
abilities.desc_zh:
在第 6 級，你獲得了額外的偏好地形。

在第 6 級，你可以選擇一個額外的宿敵以及相關的語言。你的選擇應該反映你在冒險中遇到的怪物的類型。
abilities.desc_en:
At 6th level, you gain an additional favored terrain.

At 6th level, you choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language. Your choice should reflect the types of monsters you have encountered on your adventures.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 7 級，你可以選擇以下特性之一：逃離部落、多重攻擊防禦或鋼鐵意志。
abilities.desc_en: At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will.

abilities.desc_zh: 對你的機會攻擊是在不利的情況下進行的。
abilities.desc_en: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

abilities.desc_zh: 當生物攻擊你時，你在回合剩餘時間對抗生物隨後進行的所有攻擊獲得+4的AC加值。
abilities.desc_en: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 你在對抗恐懼的豁免檢定方面具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 7 級開始，在你的任何回合中，當你的野獸夥伴沒有攻擊時，你可以使用附贈動作來命令野獸在其回合中採取衝刺、脫離、閃避或幫助動作。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 7th level, on any of your turns when your beast companion doesn't attack, you can use a bonus action to command the beast to take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action on its turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 8 級開始，穿越非魔法的困難地形不需要額外的移動。你也可以穿過非魔法植物，而不會被它們減慢速度，如果它們有刺、刺或類似的危險，也不會受到它們的傷害。

此外，你在對抗那些透過魔法創造或操縱來阻礙移動的植物（例如由糾纏法術創造的植物）時具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 8th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 10 級開始，你可以花 1 分鐘為自己創建偽裝。你必須能夠接觸到新鮮的泥土、污垢、植物、煙灰和其他天然材料來製作你的偽裝。

一旦你以這種方式偽裝，你可以透過將自己壓在至少與你一樣高和寬的堅固表面上來隱藏，例如樹或牆。只要你待在那裡不移動或採取行動，你的敏捷（潛行）檢定就會獲得+10加值。一旦你移動或採取行動或反應，你必須再次偽裝自己才能獲得這種好處。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 10th level, you can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. You must have access to fresh mud, dirt, plants, soot, and other naturally occurring materials with which to create your camouflage.

Once you are camouflaged in this way, you can try to hide by pressing yourself up against a solid surface, such as a tree or wall, that is at least as tall and wide as you are. You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks as long as you remain there without moving or taking actions. Once you move or take an action or a reaction, you must camouflage yourself again to gain this benefit.

abilities.desc_zh: 你獲得了額外的有利地形。
abilities.desc_en: You gain an additional favored terrain.

abilities.desc_zh: 11級時，你可以選擇以下特性之一：齊射或旋風攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Volley or Whirlwind Attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用你的動作對你在武器射程內可以看到的點 10 呎內的任意數量的生物進行遠程攻擊。像平常一樣，你必須為每個目標準備彈藥，並且你為每個目標進行單獨的攻擊檢定。
abilities.desc_en: You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, and you make a separate attack roll for each target.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用你的動作對你 5 呎內任意數量的生物進行近戰攻擊，每個目標都有一個單獨的攻擊檢定。
abilities.desc_en: You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你命令野獸採取攻擊行動時，野獸可以攻擊兩次或採取多重攻擊行動（如果它有該行動）。
abilities.desc_en: When you command the beast to take the Attack action, the beast can attack twice or take the Multiattack action if it has that action.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 14 級開始，你可以在你的回合中使用隱藏動作作為附贈動作。此外，除非你選擇留下蹤跡，否則你無法透過非魔法手段被追蹤。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn. Also, you can't be tracked by nonmagical means, unless you choose to leave a trail.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 14 級，你可以選擇一個額外的宿敵以及相關的語言。你的選擇應該反映你在冒險中遇到的怪物的類型。
abilities.desc_en: At 14th level, you choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language. Your choice should reflect the types of monsters you have encountered on your adventures.

abilities.desc_zh: 在 15 級時，你可以選擇以下特性之一：閃避、逆流而上或不可思議閃避。
abilities.desc_en: At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以靈活地躲避某些區域效果，例如紅龍的火焰吐息或閃電法術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。
abilities.desc_en: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a lightning bolt spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

abilities.desc_zh: 當敵對生物的近戰攻擊錯過你時，你可以使用你的反應迫使生物對你選擇的另一個生物（除了它自己）重複相同的攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你看到的攻擊者攻擊你時，你可以利用你的反應將攻擊對你造成的傷害減半。
abilities.desc_en: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 15 級開始，當你施展針對自己的法術時，如果你的野獸同伴距離你 30 呎以內，你也可以用該法術影響你的野獸夥伴。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 15th level, when you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

abilities.desc_zh: 18級時，你獲得了超自然的感官，可以幫助你對抗看不見的生物。當你攻擊一個你看不到的生物時，你看不到它不會為你的攻擊檢定帶來不利。你也知道你周圍 30 呎內任何隱形生物的位置，前提是該生物沒有對你隱藏，而且你沒有失明或失聰。
abilities.desc_en: At 18th level, you gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it. You are also aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet of you, provided that the creature isn't hidden from you and you aren't blinded or deafened.

abilities.desc_zh: 20級時，你將成為無與倫比的敵人獵人。在你的每個回合中，你可以將你的感知調整值加到你對你最喜歡的敵人之一的攻擊檢定或傷害檢定。你可以選擇在擲骰之前或之後、但在應用擲骰的任何效果之前使用此特性。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, you become an unparalleled hunter of your enemies. Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or the damage roll of an attack you make against one of your favored enemies. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

abilities.desc_zh: 選擇兩項已熟練的技能，或一項已熟練的技能與盜賊工具。使用所選技能或工具進行檢定時，熟練加值加倍。
abilities.desc_en: Choose two proficient skills, or one proficient skill and your thieves' tools. Double your proficiency bonus for checks made with the chosen skills or tool.

abilities.desc_zh: 每回合一次，當你使用靈巧武器或遠程武器命中，且該次攻擊檢定具有優勢時，可額外造成 1d6 傷害。如果目標 5 呎內有另一名未陷入失能狀態的敵人，且你的攻擊檢定不具有劣勢，則無須具有優勢也能使用偷襲。額外傷害會隨浪客等級提高。
abilities.desc_en: Once per turn, when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage on the attack roll, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage. You do not need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy is not incapacitated, and your attack roll does not have disadvantage. The extra damage increases with your rogue level.

abilities.desc_zh: 你理解並能使用賊話。以賊話傳遞訊息所需的時間是一般對話的四倍；你也能理解用來傳達簡短訊息的秘密標記與符號。
abilities.desc_en: You understand and can use Thieves' Cant. Conveying a message in Thieves' Cant takes four times as long as ordinary speech. You also understand secret signs and symbols used to communicate short messages.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 2 級開始，你的快速思維和敏捷性使你能夠快速行動和行動。你可以在戰鬥的每個回合中採取額外動作。此操作只能用於執行「衝刺」、「脫離」或「隱藏」操作。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 2nd level, your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第3級開始，當你施放法師之手時，你可以使幽靈之手隱形，並且你可以用它執行以下附加任務：

• 你可以將手上拿著的一個物體存放在另一個生物所穿戴或攜帶的容器中。
• 你可以取回另一個生物所穿戴或所攜帶的容器中的物體。
• 你可以使用盜賊的工具在一定範圍內開鎖並解除陷阱。

如果你成功通過了與生物的感知（感知）檢定相對抗的敏捷（功夫）檢定，你就可以在不被生物注意到的情況下執行其中一項任務。

此外，你也可以使用狡猾行動所賦予的加值行動來控製手牌。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 3rd level, when you cast mage hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible, and you can perform the following additional tasks with it:

• You can stow one object the hand is holding in a container worn or carried by another creature.
• You can retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature.
• You can use thieves' tools to pick lock and disarm traps at range.

You can perform one of these tasks without being noticed by a creature if you succeed on a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature's Wisdom (Perception) check.

In addition, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to control the hand.

abilities.desc_zh: 智力是你對巫師法術的施法能力，因為你透過專門的學習和記憶來學習法術。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智力。此外，在為你施放的法師法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你會使用你的智力修正值。
abilities.desc_en: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells, since you learn your spells through dedicated study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 3 級開始，當你落在敵人身上時，你就處於最致命的狀態。對於任何尚未在戰鬥中回合的生物，你在攻擊檢定上具有優勢。此外，你對受到驚訝的生物所獲得的任何命中都是致命一擊。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 3rd level, you are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 3 級開始，你可以使用「狡猾行動」所授予的加值行動來進行「敏捷」（巧手）檢定，使用盜賊的工具解除陷阱或打開鎖，或採取「使用物體」行動。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你在第 3 級選擇這個原型時，你將獲得比平常更快的攀爬能力；攀爬不再需要你額外的運動。

此外，當你進行奔跑跳躍時，你移動的距離會增加等於你的敏捷調整值的呎數。
abilities.desc_en:
When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement.

In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 5 級開始，當你看到的攻擊者攻擊你時，你可以使用你的反應將攻擊對你造成的傷害減半。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 5th level, when an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 6 級，你可以選擇另外兩項你的熟練程度（技能或盜賊工具）來獲得專業知識的好處。
abilities.desc_en: At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or with thieves' tools) to gain the benefit of Expertise.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 7 級開始，你可以靈活地躲避某些區域效果，例如紅龍的火焰吐息或冰風暴法術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 7th level, you can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or an ice storm spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 9 級開始，如果你在對某個生物施展法術時處於隱藏狀態，則該生物在本回合針對該法術進行的任何豁免檢定中都會處於劣勢。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 9th level, if you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, the creature has disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell this turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 9 級開始，你可以準確無誤地為自己創造虛假身分。你必須花費 7 天和 25 gp 來確定某個身分的歷史、職業和隸屬關係。你無法建立屬於他人的身分。例如，你可能會獲得合適的服裝、介紹信和看似正式的證書，以證明自己是來自偏遠城市的貿易公司的成員，這樣你就可以混入其他富商的公司。

此後，如果你採用新的身分作為偽裝，其他生物就會相信你就是那個人，除非有明顯的理由不這麼做。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 9th level, you can unfailingly create false identities for yourself. You must spend seven days and 25 gp to establish the history, profession, and affiliations for an identity. You can't establish an identity that belongs to someone else. For example, you might acquire appropriate clothing, letters of introduction, and official-looking certification to establish yourself as a member of a trading house from a remote city so you can insinuate yourself into the company of other wealthy merchants.

Thereafter, if you adopt the new identity as a disguise, other creatures believe you to be that person until given an obvious reason not to.

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 9 級開始，如果你在同一回合的移動速度不超過一半，你在敏捷（潛行）檢定中具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了 11 級，你已經完善了你所選擇的技能，直到它們接近完美。每當你進行能力檢定以增加你的熟練加值時，你可以將 9 或更低的 d20 檢定視為 10。
abilities.desc_en: By 11th level, you have refined your chosen skills until they approach perfection. Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

abilities.desc_zh: 13級時，你獲得了用法師之手分散目標注意力的能力。作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以指定該法術所創造的幽靈手 5 呎範圍內的一個生物。這樣做可以讓你在對抗生物的攻擊骰上獲得優勢，直到回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: At 13th level, you gain the ability to distract targets with your mage hand. As a bonus action on your turn, you can designate a creature within 5 feet of the spectral hand created by the spell. Doing so gives you advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of the turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 13 級，你獲得準確模仿他人言語、寫作和行為的能力。你必須花至少三個小時來研究這個人行為的這三個組成部分：聽演講、檢視筆跡和觀察習慣。

對不經意的觀察者來說，你的詭計是難以察覺的。如果一個警覺的生物懷疑有什麼不對勁，你在進行任何魅力（欺騙）檢定時都有優勢以避免被發現。
abilities.desc_en:
At 13th level, you gain the ability to unerringly mimic another person's speech, writing, and behavior. You must spend at least three hours studying these three components of the person's behavior, listening to speech, examining handwriting, and observing mannerism.

Your ruse is indiscernible to the casual observer. If a wary creature suspects something is amiss, you have advantage on any Charisma (Deception) check you make to avoid detection.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了 13 級，你已經對魔法的運作有了足夠的了解，你可以即興使用物品，即使它們不是為你設計的。你忽略了所有使用魔法物品的職業、種族和等級要求。
abilities.desc_en: By 13th level, you have learned enough about the workings of magic that you can improvise the use of items even when they are not intended for you. You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 14 級開始，如果你能夠聽到，你就能知道你 10 呎內任何隱藏或隱形生物的位置。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 14th level, if you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.

abilities.desc_zh: 到了15級，你已經獲得了更強的精神力量。你獲得智慧豁免檢定的熟練度。
abilities.desc_en: By 15th level, you have acquired greater mental strength. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

abilities.desc_zh:
17級時，你獲得了從另一個施法者那裡神奇地竊取如何施展法術的知識的能力。

在生物施展以你為目標或將你納入其效果範圍內的法術後，你可以立即使用你的反應來迫使該生物使用其施法能力調整值進行豁免檢定。 DC 等於你的法術豁免 DC。如果豁免失敗，你會否定該法術對你的效果，並且如果該法術的知識至少為 1 級並且達到你可以施展的等級（不需要是法師法術），你就會竊取該法術的知識。在接下來的 8 小時內，你知道該法術並可以使用你的法術位施展它。在 8 小時過去之前，該生物無法施展該法術。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。
abilities.desc_en:
At 17th level, you gain the ability to magically steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from another spellcaster.

Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a saving throw with its spellcasting ability modifier. The DC equals your spell save DC. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you, and you steal the knowledge of the spell if it is at least 1st level and of a level you can cast (it doesn't need to be a wizard spell). For the next 8 hours, you know the spell and can cast it using your spell slots. The creature can't cast that spell until the 8 hours have passed.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 17 級開始，你就成為了速死大師。當你攻擊並擊中一個受到驚訝的生物時，它必須進行一次體質豁免檢定（DC 8 + 你的敏捷調整值 + 你的熟練加值）。如果豁免失敗，你對該生物的攻擊造成的傷害加倍。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 17th level, you become a master of instant death. When you attack and hit a creature that is surprised, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, double the damage of your attack against the creature.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你達到17級時，你已經擅長伏擊並快速逃離危險。在任何戰鬥的第一輪中，你可以進行兩個回合。你以正常主動度進行第一輪，以負 10 的主動度進行第二輪。當你感到驚訝時，你無法使用此特性。
abilities.desc_en: When you reach 17th level, you have become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. You can't use this feature when you are surprised.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，你的躲避能力很強，攻擊者很少能在對抗你時佔據上風。當你沒有喪失行動能力時，任何攻擊檢定都對你沒有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 18th level, you are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.

abilities.desc_zh:
在 20 級時，你擁有在需要時取得成功的不可思議的本領。如果你的攻擊未命中範圍內的目標，你可以將未命中變成命中。或者，如果你未通過能力檢查，你可以將 d20 檢定視為 20。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
At 20th level, you have an uncanny knack for succeeding when you need to. If your attack misses a target within range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 1 級時選擇一種龍族祖先及其傷害類型。你能讀寫並說龍語；與龍互動時，若進行魅力檢定，任何適用的熟練加值均加倍。
abilities.desc_en: At 1st level, choose a draconic ancestor and its associated damage type. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. When making a Charisma check while interacting with dragons, double any proficiency bonus that applies.

abilities.desc_zh: 1 級時生命值上限額外增加 1，此後每升一級再增加 1。未穿著護甲時，護甲等級為 13 + 敏捷調整值。
abilities.desc_en: At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level. While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 13 + Dexterity modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 1 級起，當你施放 1 環或更高環級的術師法術後，DM 可要求你擲 d20；若擲出 1，則擲 d100 並依狂野魔法潮湧表產生效果。每回合最多進行一次此判定。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 1st level, after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, roll a d100 and apply the corresponding result from the Wild Magic Surge table. This check can occur at most once per turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次長休間，可使自己的一次攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免具有優勢。使用後，DM 可在你施放 1 環或更高環級的術師法術時，直接要求你擲狂野魔法潮湧表；完成後便恢復此能力。
abilities.desc_en: Once per long rest, you can gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. After you use this feature, the DM can have you roll directly on the Wild Magic Surge table when you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher; after resolving the surge, you regain this feature.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第一級，你選擇一種龍作為你的祖先。與每條龍相關的傷害類型將由你稍後獲得的特性使用。

|龍|損壞類型 |
| --- | --- |
|黑色|酸|
|藍色|閃電|
|黃銅|火|
|銅獎|閃電|
|銅|酸|
|黃金|火|
|綠色|毒|
|紅色|火|
|銀 |寒冷|
|白色|寒冷|

你可以說、讀、寫龍語。此外，每當你在與龍互動時進行魅力檢定時，如果適用於該檢定，你的熟練加值就會加倍。
abilities.desc_en:
At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

| Dragon | Damage Type |
| --- | --- |
| Black | Acid |
| Blue | Lightning |
| Brass | Fire |
| Bronze | Lightning |
| Copper | Acid |
| Gold | Fire |
| Green | Poison |
| Red | Fire |
| Silver | Cold |
| White | Cold |

You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your Proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

abilities.desc_zh:
當魔法流過你的身體時，你的龍祖先的身體特徵就會顯現出來。在第 1 級，你的最大生命值增加 1，並且每當你在該等級中獲得一個等級時，你的生命值最大值就會再次增加 1。

此外，你的部分皮膚還覆蓋著一層薄薄的龍鱗狀光澤。當你不穿盔甲時，你的 AC 等於 13 + 你的敏捷調整值。
abilities.desc_en:
As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.

Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你在第一級選擇這個起源時開始，你的施法可以釋放出狂野的魔法。在你施放 1 級或更高等級的術士法術後，DM 可以立即讓你擲 d20。如果你擲出 1，則在狂野魔法湧動桌上擲出隨機魔法效果。每回合可以發生一次狂野魔法湧動。

如果狂野魔法效果是一個法術，那麼它太狂野而不會受到超魔的影響。如果平常需要集中註意力的話，那麼此時就不需要集中註意力了；該法術持續到其整個持續時間。

| 93-94 | 93-94你的尺寸在下一分鐘增加一個尺寸職業。 |
