abilities.desc_en:
Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect. A Wild Magic Surge can happen once per turn.

If a Wild Magic effect is a spell, it's too wild to be affected by Metamagic. If it normally requires concentration, it doesn't require concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.

| d100 | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 01-02 | Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls. |
| 03-04 | For the next minute, you can see any invisible creature if you have line of sight to it. |
| 05-06 | A modron chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. |
| 07-08 | You cast fireball as a 3rd-level spell centered on yourself. |
| 09-10 | You cast magic missile as a 5th-level spell. |
| 11-12 | Roll a d10. Your height changes by a number of inches equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you shrink. If the roll is even, you grow. |
| 13-14 | You cast confusion centered on yourself. |
| 15-16 | For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns. |
| 17-18 | You grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze, at which point the feathers explode out from your face. |
| 19-20 | You cast grease centered on yourself. |
| 21-22 | Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw. |
| 23-24 | Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. A remove curse spell can end this effect. |
| 25-26 | An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute. |
| 27-28 | For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 bonus action. |
| 29-30 | You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see. |
| 31-32 | You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, after which time you return to the space you previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. |
| 33-34 | Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute. |
| 35-36 | Roll a d10. Your age changes by a number of years equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you get younger (minimum 1 year old). If the roll is even, you get older. |
| 37-38 | 1d6 flumphs controlled by the DM appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you and are frightened of you. They vanish after 1 minute. |
| 39-40 | You regain 2d10 hit points. |
| 41-42 | You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While a plant, you are incapacitated and have vulnerability to all damage. If you drop to 0 hit points, your pot breaks, and your form reverts. |
| 43-44 | For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns. |
| 45-46 | You cast levitate on yourself. |
| 47-48 | A unicorn controlled by the DM appears in a space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. |
| 49-50 | You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth. |
| 51-52 | A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to magic missile. |
| 53-54 | You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days. |
| 55-56 | Your hair falls out but grows back within 24 hours. |
| 57-58 | For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame. |
| 59-60 | You regain your lowest-level expended spell slot. |
| 61-62 | For the next minute, you must shout when you speak. |
| 63-64 | You cast fog cloud centered on yourself. |
| 65-66 | Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 lightning damage. |
| 67-68 | You are frightened by the nearest creature until the end of your next turn. |
| 69-70 | Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes invisible for the next minute. The invisibility ends on a creature when it attacks or casts a spell. |
| 71-72 | You gain resistance to all damage for the next minute. |
| 73-74 | A random creature within 60 feet of you becomes poisoned for 1d4 hours. |
| 75-76 | You glow with bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is blinded until the end of its next turn. |
| 77-78 | You cast polymorph on yourself. If you fail the saving throw, you turn into a sheep for the spell's duration. |
| 79-80 | Illusory butterflies and flower petals flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute. |
| 81-82 | You can take one additional action immediately. |
| 83-84 | Each creature within 30 feet of you takes 1d10 necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to the sum of the necrotic damage dealt. |
| 85-86 | You cast mirror image. |
| 87-88 | You cast fly on a random creature within 60 feet of you. |
| 89-90 | You become invisible for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell. |
| 91-92 | If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the reincarnate spell. |
| 93-94 | Your size increases by one size category for the next minute. |
| 95-96 | You and all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to piercing damage for the next minute. |
| 97-98 | You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute. |
| 99-100 | You regain all expended sorcery points. |

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 1 級開始，你可以操縱機會和混亂的力量，在一次攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免檢定中獲得優勢。完成此操作後，你必須完成長休才能再次使用此特性。

在你重新使用此特性之前的任何時間，DM 都可以在你施展 1 級或更高等級的術士法術後立即讓你在狂野魔法湧動桌上進行擲骰。然後你就可以重新使用此特性。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 1st level, you can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

Any time before you regain the use of this feature, the DM can have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher. You then regain the use of this feature.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第二級，你將挖掘自己內心深處的魔法泉源。這個泉源以術法點為代表，可以讓你創造出各種魔法效果
abilities.desc_en: At 2nd level, you tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects

abilities.desc_zh: 你有 2 點術法點，每次升級時都會額外獲得 1 點，在 20 級時最多獲得 20 點。你擁有的術法點永遠不會多於表中所示的你的等級。當你完成長休後，你會恢復所有消耗的術法點。
abilities.desc_en: You have 2 sorcery points, and you gain one additional point every time you level up, to a maximum of 20 at level 20. You can never have more sorcery points than shown on the table for your level. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用術法點來獲得額外的法術位，或是犧牲法術位來獲得額外的術法點。當你達到更高的水平時，你會學習其他使用術法點的方法。
abilities.desc_en: You can use your sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points. You learn other ways to use your sorcery points as you reach higher levels.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以將未消耗的術法點轉化為法術位，作為你回合中的一項附贈動作。創建的法術位在長休結束時消失。建立法術位表顯示了創建給定等級的法術位的成本。你可以創造等級不高於5級的法術位。

|法術位等級 |術法點成本|
| --- | --- |
|第一 | 2 |
|第二 | 3 |
|第三 | 5 |
|第四 | 6 |
|第五 | 7 |
abilities.desc_en:
You can transform unexpended sorcery points into one spell slot as a bonus action on your turn. The created spell slots vanish at the end of a long rest. The Creating Spell Slots table shows the cost of creating a spell slot of a given level. You can create spell slots no higher in level than 5th.

| Spell Slot Level | Sorcery Point Cost |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | 2 |
| 2nd | 3 |
| 3rd | 5 |
| 4th | 6 |
| 5th | 7 |

abilities.title_zh: 將法術位轉換為術法點
abilities.title_en: Converting a Spell Slot to Sorcery Points
abilities.desc_zh: 作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以消耗一個法術位並獲得等於法術位等級的術法點。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action on your turn, you can expend one spell slot and gain a number of sorcery points equal to the slot's level.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 3 級，你獲得了改變你的法術以滿足你的需要的能力。你可以選擇以下超魔法選項中的兩個。在第 10 級和第 17 級時你會獲得另一個。

除非另有說明，當你施展法術時，你只能使用一個超魔法選項。

選擇以下選項之一：
abilities.desc_en:
At 3rd level, you gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two of the following Metamagic options of your choice. You gain another one at 10th and 17th level.

You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

Choose one of the following:

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施放一個迫使其他生物進行豁免的法術時，你可以保護其中一些生物免受該法術的全部力量的影響。為此，你花費 1 個術法點並選擇數量不超過你的魅力調整值的生物（最少一個生物）。被選中的生物自動成功通過該法術的豁免檢定。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 sorcery point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你施展射程為 5 呎或以上的法術時，你可以花費 1 點術法點來使法術射程加倍。

當你施展具有接觸範圍的法術時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來使法術的範圍達到 30 呎。
abilities.desc_en:
When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of the spell.

When you cast a spell that has a range of touch, you can spend 1 sorcery point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你投擲法術傷害時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來重新投擲一定數量的傷害骰子，最多可達你的魅力調整值（最少 1 個）。你必須使用新的擲骰結果。

即使你在施法期間已經使用了不同的超魔法選項，你也可以使用強化法術。
abilities.desc_en:
When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施展持續時間為 1 分鐘或更長的法術時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來使其持續時間加倍，最長持續時間為 24 小時。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施放一個法術，迫使一個生物進行豁免檢定來抵抗其效果時，你可以花費 3 點魔法值，使一個目標在對抗該法術的第一次豁免檢定中處於劣勢。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施放一個施法時間為 1 個動作的法術時，你可以花費 2 個術法點將施法時間改為該施法的 1 個附贈動作。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施展法術時，你可以花費 1 個法術點來施展它，而無需任何軀體或言語成分。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施展的法術沒有自身範圍並且無法以該法術當前等級瞄準多個生物時，你可以花費等於該法術等級的術法點來用相同法術瞄準範圍內的第二個生物（如果該法術是戲法，則為1術法點）。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast a spell that doesn't have a range of self and is incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell's current level, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

abilities.desc_zh:
從 6 級開始，當你施放一個造成與你的龍類血統相關類型傷害的法術時，將你的魅力調整值加到一次傷害檢定中。

此外，你可以花費1點魔法點數來獲得對該傷害類型的抵抗力，持續1小時。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll.

In addition, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 6 級開始，你就有能力使用狂野魔法扭轉命運。當你看到的另一個生物進行攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免檢定時，你可以使用你的反應並花費 2 個法術點進行 1d4 擲骰，並將擲出的數字作為加值或懲罰（你的選擇）應用到該生物的擲骰上。你可以在生物擲骰後但在擲骰的任何效果發生之前執行此操作。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 6th level, you have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 10 級，你會學到一個額外的超魔法選項。
abilities.desc_en: At 10th level, you learn an additional metamagic option.

abilities.desc_zh:
14級時，你獲得從背後長出一對龍翼的能力，並獲得與你目前速度相同的飛行速度。你可以在你的回合中創造這些翅膀作為附贈動作。它們會一直持續到你在輪到你時將它們作為附贈動作解散為止。

穿著盔甲時你無法顯現你的翅膀，除非盔甲是為了容納它們而製造的，而不是為了容納你的翅膀而製造的衣服可能會在你顯現它們時被摧毀。
abilities.desc_en:
At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn.

You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

abilities.desc_zh: 14級時，你對狂野魔法的湧動有了一定的控制力。每當你在狂野魔法湧動桌上滾動時，你可以滾動兩次並使用任一數字。
abilities.desc_en: At 14th level, you gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

abilities.desc_zh: 在第 17 級，你會學到一個額外的超魔法選項。
abilities.desc_en: At 17th level, you learn an additional metamagic option.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，你可以引導龍祖先的可怕存在，讓你周圍的人感到敬畏或恐懼。作為一個動作，你可以花費 5 個法術點數來利用這種力量，並在 60 呎的距離內散發出敬畏或恐懼的光環（由你選擇）。在 1 分鐘內或直到你失去注意力（就像你正在施展集中法術一樣），在此光環中開始其回合的每個敵對生物都必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，或者被迷住（如果你選擇敬畏）或受到驚嚇（如果你選擇恐懼），直到光環結束。成功通過此豁免的生物將在 24 小時內免疫你的光環。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 18th level, you can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as if you were casting a concentration spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened (if you chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.

abilities.desc_zh: 從 18 級開始，你的法術的有害能量會增強。當你對法術擲出傷害並在任何骰子上擲出盡可能高的數字時，選擇其中一個骰子，再次擲骰子並將該骰子加到傷害中。每回合只能使用該特性一次。
abilities.desc_en: Beginning at 18th level, the harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, choose one of those dice, roll it again and add that roll to the damage. You can use the feature only once per turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 在20級時，每當你完成短休時，你就會恢復4點消耗的術法點。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, you regain 4 expended sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
• 施法能力：魅力
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 戲法：從契術師法術表選擇兩個
• 1 環法術：從契術師法術表選擇兩個
• 升級時，可將一個已知法術替換為另一個符合條件的契術師法術
• 可使用秘法法器作為施法法器
abilities.desc_en:
• Spellcasting Ability: Charisma
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Cantrips: Choose two from the warlock spell list
• 1st-Level Spells: Choose two from the warlock spell list
• When you gain a level, you can replace one known spell with another eligible warlock spell
• You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus

abilities.desc_zh:
當你學習契術師法術時，Archfey 可以讓你從擴展的法術表中進行選擇。以下法術已加入契術師法術表。

|法術等級|法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一名 |精靈之火，睡眠|
|第二 |平靜的情緒，夢幻的力量|
|第三 |眨眼，植物生長|
|第四 |支配野獸，更強的隱身性|
|第五 |似乎主宰人|
abilities.desc_en:
The Archfey lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

| Spell Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | faerie fire, sleep |
| 2nd | calm emotions, phantasmal force |
| 3rd | blink, plant growth |
| 4th | dominate beast, greater invisibility |
| 5th | dominate person, seeming |

abilities.desc_zh:
從第一級開始，你的守護神賦予你投射精類迷人而可怕的存在的能力。作為一個動作，你可以使來自你的 10 呎立方體中的每個生物對你的契術師法術豁免 DC 進行一次感知豁免檢定。豁免檢定失敗的生物都會被你魅惑或恐懼（你的選擇），直到你的下一個回合結束。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。

邪魔

你已經與一個來自低等存在層面的惡魔簽訂了契約，一個目標是邪惡的存在，即使你努力反對這些目標。這些存有渴望腐化或毀滅所有事物，最終包括你。強大到足以締結契約的惡魔包括惡魔領主，如狄摩高根、奧庫斯、弗拉茲烏魯和巴風特；大惡魔如阿斯摩蒂爾斯、迪斯帕特、梅菲斯特和貝利亞；特別強大的深獄煉魔和巴洛爾；以及尤格洛斯人和其他尤格洛斯人的領主。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 1st level, your patron bestows upon you the ability to project the beguiling and fearsome presence of the fey. As an action, you can cause each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. The creatures that fail their saving throws are all charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of your next turn.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

The Fiend

You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence, a being whose aims are evil, even if you strive against those aims. Such beings desire the corruption or destruction of all things, ultimately including you. Fiends powerful enough to forge a pact include demon lords such as Demogorgon, Orcus, Fraz'Urb-luu, and Baphomet; archdevils such as Asmodeus, Dispater, Mephistopheles, and Belial; pit fiends and balors that are especially mighty; and ultroloths and other lords of the yugoloths.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你學習契術師法術時，惡魔可以讓你從擴展的法術表中選擇。以下法術已加入契術師法術表。

|法術等級|法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |燃燒的雙手，命令|
|第二 |失明/耳聾，灼熱射線|
|第三 |火球，臭雲|
|第四 |防火盾，火牆|
|第五 |火焰衝擊，神聖|
abilities.desc_en:
The Fiend lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

| Spell Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | burning hands, command |
| 2nd | blindness/deafness, scorching ray |
| 3rd | fireball, stinking cloud |
| 4th | fire shield, wall of fire |
| 5th | flame strike, hallow |

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 1 級開始，當你將敵對生物的生命值減少到 0 時，你將獲得臨時生命值，生命值等於你的魅力調整值 + 你的契術師等級（至少 1）。

舊日支配者

你的宗主是一個神秘的實體，其本質與現實完全陌生。它可能來自遙遠的國度，超越現實的空間，也可能是傳說中的一位古代神靈。它的動機對凡人來說是難以理解的，它的知識是如此巨大和古老，以至於即使是最偉大的圖書館與它所蘊藏的巨大秘密相比也顯得黯然失色。舊日支配者可能不知道你的存在，或對你完全漠不關心，但你所學到的秘密可以讓你從中汲取魔法。這種類型的實體包括關納達爾（Ghaunadar），稱為潛伏者（That Which Lurks）；塔瑞茲頓，被束縛的神；丹達爾，暗夜巨蛇；扎貢，回歸者；偉大的克蘇魯；以及其他深不可測的生物。
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum of 1).

The Great Old One

Your patron is a mysterious entity whose nature is utterly foreign to the fabric of reality. It might come from the Far Realm, the space beyond reality, or it could be one of the elder gods known only in legends. Its motives are incomprehensible to mortals, and its knowledge so immense and ancient that even the greatest libraries pale in comparison to the vast secrets it holds. The Great Old One might be unaware of your existence or entirely indifferent to you, but the secrets you have learned allow you to draw your magic from it. Entities of this type include Ghaunadar, called That Which Lurks; Tharizdun, the Chained God; Dendar, the Night Serpent; Zargon, the Returner; Great Cthulhu; and other unfathomable beings.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你學習契術師法術時，舊日支配者可以讓你從擴展的法術表中進行選擇。以下法術已加入契術師法術表。

|法術等級|法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |不和諧的低語，塔莎可怕的笑聲|
|第二 |探測思想、幻像力量|
|第三 |千里眼，發送|
|第四 |主宰野獸，埃瓦德的黑色觸手|
|第五 |支配人，心靈遙感|
abilities.desc_en:
The Great Old One lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

| Spell Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | dissonant whispers, Tasha's hideous laughter |
| 2nd | detect thoughts, phantasmal force |
| 3rd | clairvoyance, sending |
| 4th | dominate beast, Evard's black tentacles |
| 5th | dominate person, telekinesis |

abilities.desc_zh: 從第一級開始，你的外星知識使你能夠接觸其他生物的思想。你可以與 30 呎內你能看到的任何生物進行心靈感應交流。你不需要與該生物共享一種語言，它就能理解你的心靈感應話語，但生物必須能夠理解至少一種語言。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 1st level, your alien knowledge gives you the ability to touch the minds of other creatures. You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施放魔能爆炸時，將你的魅力調整值加到它擊中時造成的傷害上。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast eldritch blast, add your Charisma modifier to the damage it deals on a hit.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以創建一種隨身武器或長臂的契約武器，並且可以將魔法隨身武器或長臂轉變為你的契約武器。
abilities.desc_en: You can create a pact weapon that is a sidearm or long arm, and you can transform a magical sidearm or long arm into your pact weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意為自己鑄造法師護甲，無需消耗法術位或材料成分。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast mage armor on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意對自己施展懸浮術，無需消耗法術位或材料成分。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast levitate on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

abilities.desc_zh: 你已經贏得了月之少女的青睞。你不再需要睡覺，也不能用任何方式強迫你睡覺。為了獲得長休的好處，你可以花 8 個小時進行輕度活動，例如閱讀和看守。
abilities.desc_en: You have gained the Maiden of the Moon's favor. You no longer need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep by any means. To gain the benefits of a long rest, you can spend all 8 hours doing light activity, such as reading and keeping watch.

abilities.desc_zh: 你不再需要睡覺，也不能用任何方式強迫你睡覺。為了獲得長休的好處，你可以花 8 個小時進行輕度活動，例如閱讀《影子之書》並保持警覺。
abilities.desc_en: You no longer need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep by any means. To gain the benefits of a long rest, you can spend all 8 hours doing light activity, such as reading your Book of Shadows and keeping watch.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施放與動物交談，而不需要消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast speak with animals at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 你將熟練欺騙和說服技能。
abilities.desc_en: You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次強制。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast compulsion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
你現在可以在你的暗影之書中銘刻魔法儀式。從任意職業的法術表中選擇兩個具有儀式標籤的一級法術。這些法術不必來自同一個法術表。這些法術出現在書中，並且不計入你所知道的法術數量。拿著你的暗影之書，你可以依照儀式施展所選的法術。除了儀式之外，你不能施展這些法術，除非你透過其他方式學會了它們。你也可以施放一個你知道為儀式的契術師法術（如果它有儀式標籤）。

在你的冒險中，你可以將其他儀式法術加入你的暗影之書中。當你找到這樣的法術時，如果該法術的等級等於或小於你的契術師等級的一半（無條件進位）並且你能抽出時間抄寫該法術，你就可以將其添加到書中。對於每個法術等級，轉錄過程需要 2 小時，並且需要花費 50 gp 來銘刻所需的稀有墨水。
abilities.desc_en:
You can now inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Choose two 1st-level spells that have the ritual tag from any class's spell list. The spells needn't be from the same spell list. The spells appear in the book and don't count against the number of spells you know. With your Book of Shadows in hand, you can cast the chosen spells as rituals. You can't cast the spells except as rituals, unless you've learned them by some other means. You can also cast a warlock spell you know as a ritual if it has the ritual tag.

On your adventures, you can add other ritual spells to your Book of Shadows. When you find such a spell, you can add it to the book if the spell's level is equal to or less than half your warlock level (rounded up) and if you can spare the time to transcribe the spell. For each level of the spell, the transcription process takes 2 hours and costs 50 gp for the rare inks needed to inscribe it.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為一個附贈動作，你會導致被你的六角之刃詛咒所詛咒的目標受到等同於你的魅力調整值的火焰傷害（最少為 1）。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you cause a target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse to take fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

abilities.desc_zh: 紫色之星凱豐是缺乏經驗的水手的厄運。那些利用它的欺騙性的光芒來引導他們旅行的人總是會走向滅亡。你會熟練欺騙和潛行技能，並且在對抗被魅惑的生物的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: The purple star Caiphon is the doom of inexperienced mariners. Those who use its deceptive light to guide their travels invariably come to ruin. You gain proficiency in the Deception and Stealth skills, and you have advantage on attack rolls against charmed creatures.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施放控制怪物——以天界、惡魔或元素為目標——而不需要消耗法術位或材料成分。你必須完成長休才能再次對同一個生物使用此法術。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast hold monster at will—targeting a celestial, fiend, or elemental—without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a long rest before you can use this invocation on the same creature again.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為一個附贈動作，你可以讓冰霜在被你的六角之刃詛咒所詛咒的目標周圍旋轉，對目標 5 呎內的每個敵人造成寒冷傷害。寒冷傷害等於你的魅力調整值（至少 1）。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you cause frost to swirl around a target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse, dealing cold damage to each of your enemies within 5 feet of the target. The cold damage equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以將屍體的手或類似的附肢放在你的《暗影之書》上，然後大聲問一個問題。 1分鐘後，答案就出現在你的書本上。死亡生物的靈魂盡其所能提供答案，並將其翻譯成你選擇的語言。你必須在生物死亡後 1 分鐘內使用此能力，並且只能以這種方式向特定生物詢問一個問題。
abilities.desc_en: You can place a corpse's hand or similar appendage on your Book of Shadows and ask one question aloud. After 1 minute, the answer appears written in blood in your book. The answer is provided by the dead creature's spirit to the best of its knowledge and is translated into a language of your choice. You must use this ability within 1 minute of a creature's death, and a given creature can only be asked one question in this manner.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用刀鋒契約特性來創造黑色鉛連枷。連枷的頭部雕刻成一對抓握的觸手。該武器具有觸及屬性。當你用它擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個法術位來對目標每法術等級造成額外2d8的壞死傷害，並且你可以將生物的速度降低到0呎，直到你的下回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: You can create a black, lead flail using your Pact of the Blade feature. The flail's head is sculpted to resemble a pair of grasping tentacles. The weapon has the reach property. When you hit a creature with it, you can expend a spell slot to deal an additional 2d8 necrotic damage to the target per spell level, and you can reduce the creature's speed to 0 feet until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為附贈動作，你可以召喚一群嗡嗡作響的蒼蠅在你周圍。群體讓你在魅力（恐嚇）檢定上獲得優勢，但在所有其他魅力檢定上處於劣勢。此外，在你 5 呎範圍內開始回合的生物會受到等同於你的魅力調整值的毒素傷害。你可以透過另一個附贈動作來解散蜂群。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you can conjure a swarm of buzzing flies around you. The swarm grants you advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks but disadvantage on all other Charisma checks. In addition, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you takes poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier. You can dismiss the swarm with another bonus action.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為附贈動作，你可以讓自己周圍充滿神奇的光環，看起來就像嗡嗡作響的蒼蠅。光環包括你的空間，從你向各個方向延伸 5 呎，並被完全遮蔽所阻擋。它會一直持續到你喪失行為能力或你透過附贈動作將其解除為止。

該光環使你在魅力（恐嚇）檢定上具有優勢，但在所有其他魅力檢定上處於劣勢。任何其他在該光環中開始回合的生物都會受到等於你的魅力調整值的毒素傷害（最少 0 點傷害）。

一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
As a bonus action, you can surround yourself with a magical aura that looks like buzzing flies. The aura includes your space, extends 5 feet from you in every direction, and is blocked by total cover. It lasts until you're incapacitated or you dismiss it with a bonus action.

The aura grants you advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks but disadvantage on all other Charisma checks. Any other creature that starts its turn in the aura takes poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 0 damage).

Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以使用你的刀鋒契約特性來打造一把銀質巨劍，劍刃上刻有黑色符文。如果你用這把劍將被你的六角之刃詛咒所詛咒的目標的生命值減少到 0，你可以立即將詛咒的目標更改為其他生物。此更改不會延長詛咒的持續時間。

當你用此武器擊中生物時，你可以花費一個法術位，對目標每法術等級造成額外2d8的切割傷害，並且你可以將生物的速度降低至0呎，直到你的下回合結束。
abilities.desc_en:
You can create a greatsword forged from silver, with black runes etched into its blade, using your Pact of the Blade feature. If you reduce a target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse to 0 hit points with this sword, you can immediately change the target of the curse to a different creature. This change doesn't extend the curse's duration.

When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can expend a spell slot to deal an additional 2d8 slashing damage to the target per spell level, and you can reduce the creature's speed to 0 feet until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以在黑暗中正常看到 120 呎的距離，無論是魔法黑暗還是非魔法黑暗。
abilities.desc_en: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次混亂。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast confusion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施展探測魔法，無需消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast detect magic at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 每回合一次，當你用契約武器擊中生物時，你可以消耗一個契術師法術位，對目標造成額外 1d8 點力量傷害，再加上每級法術位 1d8 點傷害。如果目標受到任何此類傷害，如果目標是巨型或更小，你可以將其擊倒。
abilities.desc_en: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a warlock spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 force damage to the target, plus another 1d8 per level of the spell slot. If the target takes any of this damage, you can knock the target prone if it is Huge or smaller.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你施放恐怖爆炸時，範圍為 300 呎。
abilities.desc_en: When you cast eldritch blast, its range is 300 feet.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以閱讀所有文字。
abilities.desc_en: You can read all writing.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意對自己施展虛假生命作為1級法術，無需消耗法術位或材料成分。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a spell slot or material components.

abilities.desc_zh: 你利用冰霜王子的天賦將你的敵人困在冰中。當你在你的回合中用你的可怕爆炸法術擊中一個生物一次或多次時，你可以將該生物的速度降低10呎，直到你的下一個回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: You draw on the gifts of the Prince of Frost to trap your enemies in ice. When you hit a creature with your eldritch blast cantrip one or more times on your turn, you can reduce that creature's speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的每個回合中，當你用魔能爆炸擊中一個生物時，你可以將生物的速度降低10呎，直到你的下一個回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast, you can reduce that creature's speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 你獲得了藍星基拉德銳利的目光。作為一個動作，你可以看穿30呎範圍內的固體物體，直到當前回合結束。在那段時間裡，你將物體視為幽靈般的透明圖像。
abilities.desc_en: You gain the piercing gaze of the blue star Khirad. As an action, you can see through solid objects to a range of 30 feet until the end of the current turn. During that time, you perceive objects as ghostly, transparent images.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以用你的動作去觸摸一個願意的人形生物並透過它的感官進行感知，直到你的下一個回合結束。只要生物與你處於同一存在位面，你就可以在後續回合中使用你的行動來維持這種聯繫，將持續時間延長到你的下一個回合結束。當透過其他生物的感官進行感知時，你會受益於該生物所擁有的任何特殊感官，並且你對自己的周圍環境感到盲目和耳聾。
abilities.desc_en: You can use your action to touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can use your action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為一個動作，你獲得了看穿 30 呎範圍內的固體物體的能力。在這個範圍內，如果你還沒有黑暗視覺，你就擁有它。這種特殊景象會持續到目前回合結束。在那段時間裡，你將物體視為幽靈般的透明圖像。一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en: As an action, you gain the ability to see through solid objects to a range of 30 feet. Within that range, you have darkvision if you don't already have it. This special sight lasts until the end of the current turn. During that time, you perceive objects as ghostly, transparent images. Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以在水下呼吸，你的游泳速度等於你的步行速度。你也可以在不消耗法術位的情況下施放水下呼吸。一旦你使用此魔能祈喚施放了它，你就無法再次這樣做，直到你完成長休。
abilities.desc_en: You can breathe underwater, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. You can also cast water breathing without expending a spell slot. Once you cast it using this invocation, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.title_en: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones v2
abilities.desc_zh: 每當你在魔寵距離你 100 呎以內時重新獲得生命值時，將擲出的任何骰子視為已為你重新獲得的生命值最大值。
abilities.desc_en: Whenever you regain hit points while your familiar is within 100 feet of you, treat any dice rolled to determine the hit points you regain as having rolled their maximum value for you.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的回合中，當你用魔能爆炸戲法擊中一個生物時，你可以將該生物沿直線移動到離你更近10呎的地方。
abilities.desc_en: Once during your turn when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast cantrip, you can move that creature in a straight line 10 feet closer to yourself.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的每個回合中，當你用魔能爆炸戲法擊中一個生物時，你可以將該生物沿直線移動到離你更近10呎的地方。
abilities.desc_en: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast cantrip, you can move that creature in a straight line 10 feet closer to yourself.

abilities.desc_zh: 綠色領主掌管永恆夏日的翠綠王國。你的靈魂與他的力量息息相關。每當你重新獲得生命值時，你都會將擲骰子來確定你重新獲得的生命值視為已擲出其最大值。
abilities.desc_en: The Green Lord oversees a verdant realm of everlasting summer. Your soul is linked to his power. Whenever you regain hit points, you treat any dice rolled to determine the hit points you regain as having rolled their maximum value.

abilities.desc_zh: 你使用劍刃契約特性所創造的任何武器都是+1武器。此呼喚不會影響你轉變為契約武器的魔法武器。
abilities.desc_en: Any weapon you create using your Pact of the Blade feature is a +1 weapon. This invocation doesn't affect a magic weapon you transformed into your pact weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用你透過劍刃契約召喚的任何武器作為契術師法術的施法焦點。此外，該武器算作魔法武器，其攻擊和傷害檢定有 +1 加值，除非它已經是你轉變為契約武器的魔法武器。
abilities.desc_en: You can use any weapon you summon with your Pact of the Blade feature as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells. In addition, the weapon counts as a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, unless it is already a magic weapon that you transformed into your pact weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以透過你的魔能爆炸來引導梅菲斯特的火焰。當你用該戲法擊中生物時，你可以使用契術師法術位施放火球術作為附贈動作。然而，該法術必須集中在你用邪能爆炸擊中的生物上。
abilities.desc_en: You can channel the fires of Mephistopheles through your eldritch blast. When you hit a creature with that cantrip, you can cast fireball as a bonus action using a warlock spell slot. However, the spell must be centered on a creature you hit with eldritch blast.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用魔能爆炸擊中生物時，你可以使用契術師法術位施放火球術作為附贈動作。該法術必須集中在你用怪異爆炸擊中的生物上。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with your eldritch blast, you can cast fireball as a bonus action using a warlock spell slot. The spell must be centered on the creature you hit with eldritch blast.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用契約武器擊中一個生物時，該生物會受到等於你的魅力調整值的額外壞死傷害（最少為 1）。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

abilities.desc_zh: 當你將契約武器打造為狼牙棒時，它會表現為一把在迪斯（九層地獄的第二層）鍛造的鐵狼牙棒。當你用它擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個法術位來對目標造成每法術等級額外的2d8力量傷害，並且如果目標是巨型或更小，你可以將目標擊倒。
abilities.desc_en: When you create your pact weapon as a mace, it manifests as an iron mace forged in Dis, the second of the Nine Hells. When you hit a creature with it, you can expend a spell slot to deal an additional 2d8 force damage to the target per spell level, and you can knock the target prone if it is Huge or smaller.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為一個附贈動作，你可以在被你的妖術法術或你的契術師特性（例如妖術之刃的詛咒和不祥之兆）詛咒的目標周圍造成精神幹擾。當你這樣做時，你會對目標及其周圍 5 呎內你選擇的每個生物造成心靈傷害。心靈傷害等於你的魅力調整值（最小傷害為 0）。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you cause a psychic disturbance around the target cursed by your hex spell or by a warlock feature of yours, such as Hexblade's Curse and Sign of Ill Omen. When you do so, you deal psychic damage to the target and each creature of your choice within 5 feet of it. The psychic damage equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of 0 damage).

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施展偽裝自我，無需消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast disguise self at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施放改變自我，而不需要消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast alter self at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次召喚元素。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast conjure elemental once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次緩慢的法術。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast slow once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施展無聲影像，無需消耗法術位或材料成分。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast silent image at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用劍刃契約特性來創造長弓。當你拉開它的繩子並開火時，它會產生一支白木箭，一分鐘後就會消失。你在用弓對抗狼人時有優勢。當你用它擊中生物時，你可以花費一個法術位來對目標每法術等級造成額外的2d8光輝傷害。
abilities.desc_en: You can create a longbow using your Pact of the Blade feature. When you draw back its string and fire, it creates an arrow of white wood, which vanishes after 1 minute. You have advantage on attack rolls against lycanthropes with the bow. When you hit a creature with it, you can expend a spell slot to deal an additional 2d8 radiant damage to the target per spell level.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你處於光線昏暗或黑暗的區域時，你可以使用你的動作變得隱形，直到你移動或採取行動或反應。
abilities.desc_en: When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible until you move or take an action or a reaction.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意對自己施展跳躍，無需消耗法術位或材料成分。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast jump on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

abilities.desc_zh: 探索者號召你去尋找知識，沒有任何事物可以阻止你走這條路。你會忽略困難的地形，在逃脫擒抱、手銬或繩索束縛的所有檢定中具有優勢，並且在對抗麻痺的豁免檢定中具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: The Seeker bids you to travel in search of knowledge, and little can prevent you from walking this path. You ignore difficult terrain, have advantage on all checks to escape a grapple, manacles, or rope bindings, and advantage on saving throws against being paralyzed.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你使用魔能爆炸戲法獲得致命一擊時，請選擇你自己或你在 30 呎內可以看到的盟友。所選生物可以立即消耗生命骰來恢復生命值，生命值等於擲骰+該生物的體質調整值（至少 1 點生命值）。
abilities.desc_en: When you score a critical hit with your eldritch blast cantrip, pick yourself or an ally you can see within 30 feet of you. The chosen creature can immediately expend a Hit Die to regain hit points equal to the roll + the creature's Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 hit point).

abilities.desc_zh: 你的六角之刃的詛咒在你和你的目標之間建立了暫時的聯繫。作為附贈動作，你可以神奇地傳送到一個你可以看到的距離被六角之刃詛咒的目標 5 呎以內的空間。為此，你必須能夠看到目標，並且距離目標必須在 30 呎以內。
abilities.desc_en: Your Hexblade's Curse creates a temporary bond between you and your target. As a bonus action, you can magically teleport to a space you can see within 5 feet of the target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse. To do so, you must be able to see the target and must be within 30 feet of it.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的詛咒在你和你的目標之間建立了暫時的連結。作為一個附贈動作，你可以神奇地傳送到 30 呎外的一個未佔據的空間，你可以看到距離被你的十六進制法術或你的契術師特性（例如六角之刃的詛咒和凶兆之兆）詛咒的目標 5 呎以內。要以這種方式傳送，你必須能夠看到被詛咒的目標。
abilities.desc_en: Your curse creates a temporary bond between you and your target. As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of the target cursed by your hex spell or by a warlock feature of yours, such as Hexblade's Curse and Sign of Ill Omen. To teleport in this way, you must be able to see the cursed target.

abilities.desc_zh: 當你用魔能爆炸擊中一個生物時，你可以將生物沿著直線推離你 10 呎。
abilities.desc_en: When you hit a creature with eldritch blast, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次變形術。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast polymorph once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
海孿生統治著妖精荒野的海洋。他們的禮物可以讓你輕鬆地在水中旅行。你可以在水下呼吸，你的游泳速度等於你的步行速度。

你也可以使用契術師法術位施放水呼吸。一旦你使用此魔能祈喚施放了它，你就無法再次這樣做，直到你完成長休。
abilities.desc_en:
The Sea Twins rule seas in the Feywild. Their gift allows you to travel through water with ease. You can breathe underwater, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

You can also cast water breathing using a warlock spell slot. Once you cast it using this invocation, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你對知識的追求使你能夠掌握任何口語。當你完成長休後，你可以選擇兩種語言。你將獲得說、讀、寫所選語言的能力，直到完成下一次長休息。
abilities.desc_en: Your quest for knowledge allows you to master any spoken language. When you complete a long rest, you can pick two languages. You gain the ability to speak, read, and write the chosen languages until you finish your next long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施展隱身術，無需消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast invisibility at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 藍白色的烏爾班星在群星中保持著變幻無常的狀態，飄進視野只是為了預示著魔能預兆。透過一個動作，你可以隱形 1 分鐘。如果你攻擊、造成傷害或強迫生物進行豁免檢定，你會在當前回合結束時變得可見。
abilities.desc_en: The blue-white star Ulban maintains a fickle presence among the stars, fluttering into view only to herald a dire omen. As an action, you can turn invisible for 1 minute. If you attack, deal damage, or force a creature to make a saving throw, you become visible at the end of the current turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次賜予詛咒。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast bestow curse once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你使用劍刃契約特性創建的任何武器都是 +2 武器。此呼喚不會影響你轉變為契約武器的魔法武器。
abilities.desc_en: Any weapon you create using your Pact of the Blade feature is a +2 weapon. This invocation doesn't affect a magic weapon you transformed into your pact weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以使用契術師法術位施放一次詛咒。在完成長休之前，你不能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast bane once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 每當你輪到你進行攻擊動作時，你可以使用契約武器攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
abilities.desc_en: You can attack with your pact weapon twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為受到傷害時的反應，你可以將自己埋在冰中，冰會在你的下一輪結束時融化。每契術師等級你獲得 10 點臨時生命值，這會承受盡可能多的觸發傷害。你也會容易受到火焰傷害，你的速度降至 0，你將失去行動能力。當冰融化時，所有這些影響都會結束。

一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
As a reaction when you take damage, you can entomb yourself in ice, which melts away at the end of your next turn. You gain 10 temporary hit points per warlock level, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. You also gain vulnerability to fire damage, your speed drops to 0, and you are incapacitated. All of these effects end when the ice melts.

Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為受到傷害時的反應，你可以將自己埋在冰中，冰會在你的下一輪結束時融化。每契術師等級你獲得 10 點臨時生命值，這會承受盡可能多的觸發傷害。你也會受到火焰傷害，你的速度會降低到 0，你會失去行動能力。當冰融化時，這些影響都會消失。

一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
As a reaction when you take damage, you can entomb yourself in ice, which melts away at the end of your next turn. You gain 10 temporary hit points per warlock level, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. You also gain vulnerability to fire damage, your speed is reduced to 0, and you are incapacitated. These effects all end when the ice melts.

Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以對自己施放一次移動自由，而無需花費法術位。當你完成長休後，你將重新獲得這樣做的能力。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast freedom of movement once on yourself without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你使用劍刃契約特性所創造的任何武器都是 +3 武器。此呼喚不會影響你轉變為契約武器的魔法武器。
abilities.desc_en: Any weapon you create using your Pact of the Blade feature is a +3 weapon. This invocation doesn't affect a magic weapon you transformed into your pact weapon.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施展奧術之眼，無需消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast arcane eye at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 只要你們處於同一存在位面，你就可以與你的魔寵進行心靈感應交流，並透過魔寵的感官進行感知。此外，在透過魔寵的感官進行感知的同時，你也可以透過魔寵用自己的聲音說話，即使你的魔寵通常無法說話。
abilities.desc_en: You can communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through your familiar's senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. Additionally, while perceiving through your familiar's senses, you can also speak through your familiar in your own voice, even if your familiar is normally incapable of speech.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施放死者說話，而不需要消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast speak with dead at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh: 當任何變形者或生物被幻像或變形魔法隱藏時，當生物在你 30 呎範圍內且在視線範圍內時，你可以看到該生物的真實形態。
abilities.desc_en: You can see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion or transmutation magic while the creature is within 30 feet of you and within line of sight.

abilities.desc_zh: 你不再需要睡覺，也不能用任何方式強迫你睡覺。為了獲得長休的好處，你可以花 8 個小時進行輕度活動，例如閱讀《影子之書》並保持警覺。
abilities.desc_en: You no longer need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep by any means. To gain the benefits of a long rest, you can spend all 8 hours doing light activity, such as reading your Book of Shadows and keeping watch.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為附贈動作，你可以讓自己周圍充滿神奇的光環，看起來就像嗡嗡作響的蒼蠅。光環向各個方向延伸距離你 5 呎，但不會完全覆蓋。它會持續到你喪失行為能力或你將其忽略作為附贈動作。

該光環使你在魅力（恐嚇）檢定上具有優勢，但在所有其他魅力檢定上處於劣勢。任何其他在該光環中開始回合的生物都會受到等於你的魅力調整值的毒素傷害（最少 0 點傷害）。

一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
As a bonus action, you can surround yourself with a magical aura that looks like buzzing flies. The aura extends 5 feet from you in every direction, but not through total cover. It lasts until you're incapacitated or you dismiss it as a bonus action.

The aura grants you advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks but disadvantage on all other Charisma checks. Any other creature that starts its turn in the aura takes poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 0 damage).

Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 每回合一次，當你用契約武器擊中一個生物時，你可以消耗一個契術師法術位對目標造成額外的 1d8 力量傷害，再加上每級法術位 1d8 點傷害，如果目標是巨型或更小，你可以將目標擊倒。
abilities.desc_en: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a warlock spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 force damage to the target, plus another 1d8 per level of the spell slot, and you can knock the target prone if it is Huge or smaller.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為一個動作，你獲得了看穿 30 呎範圍內的固體物體的能力。在這個範圍內，如果你還沒有黑暗視覺，你就擁有它。這種特殊的景象會持續 1 分鐘或直到你的注意力結束（就好像你正在專注於法術一樣）。在那段時間裡，你將物體視為幽靈般的透明圖像。

一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
As an action, you gain the ability to see through solid objects to a range of 30 feet. Within that range, you have darkvision if you don't already have it. This special sight lasts for 1 minute or until your concentration ends (as if you were concentrating on a spell). During that time, you perceive objects as ghostly, transparent images.

Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以在水下呼吸，你的游泳速度等於你的步行速度。

你也可以施放一次水呼吸，而無需消耗法術位。當你完成長休後，你將重新獲得這樣做的能力。
abilities.desc_en:
You can breathe underwater, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

You can also cast water breathing once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 每當你在魔寵距離你 100 呎以內時重新獲得生命值時，將擲出的任何骰子視為已為你重新獲得的生命值最大值。
abilities.desc_en: Whenever you regain hit points while your familiar is within 100 feet of you, treat any dice rolled to determine the hit points you regain as having rolled their maximum value for you.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的每個回合中，當你用你的可怕爆炸擊中一個生物時，你可以將生物沿著直線移動到離你更近10呎的地方。
abilities.desc_en: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast, you can move that creature in a straight line 10 feet closer to you.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以使用你透過劍刃契約召喚的任何武器作為契術師法術的施法焦點。

此外，該武器的攻擊和傷害檢定獲得+1加值，除非它是已經在這些檢定上獲得加值的魔法武器。

最後，你召喚的武器可以是短弓、長弓、輕十字弓或重十字弓。
abilities.desc_en:
You can use any weapon you summon with your Pact of the Blade feature as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells.

In addition, the weapon gains a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, unless it is a magic weapon that already has a bonus to those rolls.

Finally, the weapon you conjure can be a shortbow, longbow, light crossbow, or heavy crossbow.

abilities.desc_zh: 在你的每個回合中，當你用魔能爆炸擊中一個生物時，你可以將生物的速度降低10呎，直到你的下一個回合結束。
abilities.desc_en: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast, you can reduce that creature's speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 作為一個附贈動作，你可以在被你的妖術法術或你的契術師特性（例如妖術之刃的詛咒或不祥之兆）詛咒的目標周圍造成精神幹擾。當你這樣做時，你會對被詛咒的目標以及你選擇的在其 5 呎範圍內看到的每個生物造成心靈傷害。心靈傷害等於你的魅力調整值（最少 1 點傷害）。要使用此魔能祈喚，你必須能夠看到被詛咒的目標，並且它必須在你的 30 呎範圍內。
abilities.desc_en: As a bonus action, you cause a psychic disturbance around the target cursed by your hex spell or by a warlock feature of yours, such as Hexblade's Curse or Sign of Ill Omen. When you do so, you deal psychic damage to the cursed target and each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The psychic damage equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 damage). To use this invocation, you must be able to see the cursed target, and it must be within 30 feet of you.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的詛咒在你和你的目標之間建立了暫時的連結。作為一個附贈動作，你可以神奇地傳送到 30 呎外的一個未佔據的空間，你可以看到距離被你的十六進制法術或你的契術師特性（例如六角之刃的詛咒或凶兆之兆）詛咒的目標 5 呎以內。要以這種方式傳送，你必須能夠看到被詛咒的目標。
abilities.desc_en: Your curse creates a temporary bond between you and your target. As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of the target cursed by your hex spell or by a warlock feature of yours, such as Hexblade's Curse or Sign of Ill Omen. To teleport in this way, you must be able to see the cursed target.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以隨意施展隱身術，無需消耗法術位。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast invisibility at will, without expending a spell slot.

abilities.desc_zh:
作為受到傷害時的反應，你可以將自己埋在冰中，冰會在你的下一輪結束時融化。每契術師等級你獲得 10 點臨時生命值，這會承受盡可能多的觸發傷害。在你受到傷害後，你會立即受到火焰傷害，你的速度會降低到 0，你會失去行動能力。這些效果，包括任何剩餘的臨時生命值，都會在冰融化時結束。

一旦你使用此魔能祈喚，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
As a reaction when you take damage, you can entomb yourself in ice, which melts away at the end of your next turn. You gain 10 temporary hit points per warlock level, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. Immediately after you take the damage, you gain vulnerability to fire damage, your speed is reduced to 0, and you are incapacitated. These effects, including any remaining temporary hit points, all end when the ice melts.

Once you use this invocation, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可以對自己施放一次移動自由，而無需花費法術位。當你完成長休後，你將重新獲得這樣做的能力。
abilities.desc_en: You can cast freedom of movement once on yourself without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
你學會了尋找熟悉法術並且可以將其作為儀式施放。該法術不計入你已知的法術數量。

當你施展法術時，你可以為你的魔寵選擇一種正常形態，或選擇以下一種特殊形態：小鬼、偽龍、準星或精靈。

此外，當你採取攻擊動作時，你可以放棄自己的一次攻擊，讓你的魔寵利用它的反應來進行一次自己的攻擊。
abilities.desc_en:
You learn the find familiar spell and can cast it as a ritual. The spell doesn't count against your number of spells known.

When you cast the spell, you can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite.

Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to use its reaction to make one attack of its own.

abilities.desc_zh:
你可以用你的行動在你的空手上創造出契約武器。你可以選擇每次建立該近戰武器時所採用的形式（有關武器選項，請參閱第 5 章）。當你運用它時，你就熟練了。為了克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抵抗和免疫，這種武器被視為魔法武器。

如果你的契約武器距離你超過 5 呎並持續 1 分鐘或更長時間，它就會消失。如果你再次使用此特性，如果你關閉武器（無需執行任何操作），或者如果你死亡，它也會消失。

你可以透過在持有武器時執行特殊儀式將一件魔法武器變成你的契約武器。整個儀式需要 1 小時，可以在短休期間完成。然後你可以解散該武器，將其轉移到一個超維度空間，此後每當你創建契約武器時它都會出現。你不能以這種方式影響神器或有感知的武器。如果你死了，如果你在不同的武器上執行了 1 小時的儀式，或者如果你使用 1 小時的儀式來打破與它的聯繫，那麼該武器將不再是你的契約武器。如果在異次元空間中，當束縛斷裂時，武器就會出現在你的腳下。
abilities.desc_en:
You can use your action to create a pact weapon in your empty hand. You can choose the form that this melee weapon takes each time you create it. You are proficient with it while you wield it. This weapon counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Your pact weapon disappears if it is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute or more. It also disappears if you use this feature again, if you dismiss the weapon (no action required), or if you die.

You can transform one magic weapon into your pact weapon by performing a special ritual while you hold the weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a short rest. You can then dismiss the weapon, shunting it into an extradimensional space, and it appears whenever you create your pact weapon thereafter. You can't affect an artifact or a sentient weapon in this way. The weapon ceases being your pact weapon if you die, if you perform the 1-hour ritual on a different weapon, or if you use a 1-hour ritual to break your bond to it. The weapon appears at your feet if it is in the extradimensional space when the bond breaks.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的宗主給了你一本名為《陰影之書》的魔法書。當你獲得此特性時，從任何職業的法術表中選擇三個戲法。戲法不需要來自同一個法術表。當書在你身上時，你可以隨意施展那些戲法。它們不計入你已知的戲法數量。你使用此特性施展的任何戲法都被視為契術師戲法。如果你遺失了暗影之書，你可以舉行一個 1 小時的儀式，從你的宗主那裡獲得替代品。這個儀式可以在短休或長休時進行，它會破壞先前的書。當你死後，這本書就會化為灰燼。
abilities.desc_en: Your patron gives you a grimoire called a Book of Shadows. When you gain this feature, choose three cantrips from any class's spell list. The cantrips do not need to be from the same spell list. While the book is on your person, you can cast those cantrips at will. They don't count against your number of cantrips known. Any cantrip you cast with this feature is considered a warlock cantrip for you. If you lose your Book of Shadows, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to receive a replacement from your patron. This ceremony can be performed during a short or long rest, and it destroys the previous book. The book turns to ash when you die.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 3 級，專用於探索者的角色可以選擇此選項，而不是契術師現有的契約恩賜選項之一。

探索者會給你一條由星光鍛造的鍊子，上面裝飾著七個閃閃發光的亮度微粒。當鎖鏈戴在你身上時，你知道占卜法術並可以將其作為儀式施展。該法術不計入你已知的法術數量。

此外，當你攜帶該物品時，你可以魔能祈喚探索者的力量來在智力檢定中獲得優勢。一旦你使用了這個能力，你就不能再使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。

如果你丟失了星鏈，你可以進行 1 小時的儀式，從探索者那裡獲得替代品。該儀式可以在短休或長休期間進行，並且它會破壞先前的鏈條。當你死後，鎖鏈會在一瞬間消失。

該物品的具體形式可能會有所不同，具體取決於你的宗主。星鏈的靈感來自灰鷹神天神。
abilities.desc_en:
At 3rd level, a character dedicated to the Seeker can select this option instead of one of the warlock's existing Pact Boon options.

The Seeker grants you a chain forged from starlight, decorated with seven gleaming motes of brightness. While the chain is on your person, you know the augury spell and can cast it as a ritual. The spell doesn't count against your number of spells known.

Additionally, you can invoke the Seeker's power to gain advantage on an Intelligence check while you carry this item. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

If you lose your Star Chain, you can perform a 1-­hour ceremony to receive a replacement from the Seeker. The ceremony can be performed during a short or long rest, and it destroys the previous chain. The chain disappears in a flash of light when you die.

The exact form of this item might be different depending on your patron. The Star Chain is inspired by the Greyhawk deity Celestian.

abilities.desc_zh:
从 6 级开始，你可以在受到伤害时消失在一阵薄雾中。当你受到伤害时，你可以利用你的反应来隐形并传送到 60 呎之外的一个你可以看到的未占据的空间。你将保持隐身状态，直到你的下一个回合开始或者直到你攻击或施展法术。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。

邪魔
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 6th level, you can vanish in a puff of mist in response to harm. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You remain invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

The Fiend

abilities.desc_zh:
從 6 級開始，你可以召喚你的守護神來改變命運，使其對你有利。當你進行能力檢定或豁免檢定時，你可以使用此特性將 d10 加到你的骰子中。你可以在看到初始擲骰之後但在任何擲骰效果發生之前執行此操作。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。

舊日支配者
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 6th level, you can call on your patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add a d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

The Great Old One

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 6 級，你學會用魔法保護自己免受攻擊，並將敵人的失敗攻擊轉化為自己的好運。當生物對你進行攻擊檢定時，你可以利用你的反應來對該檢定施加不利影響。如果這次攻擊沒有擊中你，那麼如果你在下一個回合結束之前成功，那麼你對該生物的下一次攻擊檢定就會有優勢。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
abilities.desc_en:
At 6th level, you learn to magically ward yourself against attack and to turn an enemy's failed strike into good luck for yourself. When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that roll. If the attack misses you, your next attack roll against the creature has advantage if you make it before the end of your next turn.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
從 10 級開始，你的守護神會教你如何利用敵人的影響心靈的魔法來對付他們。你不會被魅惑，當另一個生物試圖魅惑你時，你可以使用你的反應來嘗試將魅惑力恢復到該生物身上。該生物必須成功通過對抗你的契術師法術來豁免 DC 的感知豁免檢定，否則就會被你魅惑 1 分鐘或直到生物受到任何傷害。

邪魔
abilities.desc_en:
Beginning at 10th level, your patron teaches you how to turn the mind-affecting magic of your enemies against them. You are immune to being charmed, and when another creature attempts to charm you, you can use your reaction to attempt to turn the charm back on that creature. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until the creature takes any damage.

The Fiend

abilities.desc_zh:
從 10 級開始，當你完成短休或長休息時，你可以選擇一種傷害類型。你將獲得對該傷害類型的抵抗力，直到你選擇具有此特性的其他傷害類型。魔法武器或銀武器造成的傷害會忽略此抗性。

舊日支配者
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 10th level, you can choose one damage type when you finish a short or long rest. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature. Damage from magical weapons or silver weapons ignores this resistance.

The Great Old One

abilities.desc_zh: 從第 10 級開始，除非你允許，否則無法透過心靈感應或其他方式讀取你的想法。你也對心靈傷害有抵抗力，每當生物對你造成心靈傷害時，生物就會受到與你所造成的傷害相同的傷害。
abilities.desc_en: Starting at 10th level, your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it. You also have resistance to psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of damage that you do.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 11 級，你的異界宗主賜給你一個名為奧秘的魔法秘密。選擇一個法術|等級=6|職業=契術師作為這個奧秘。

你可以施放一次奧術法術，而無需消耗法術位。你必須完成長休才能再次這樣做。

在更高的等級上，你可以獲得更多可以透過這種方式施放的契術師法術：13級時一個7級法術，15級時一個8級法術，17級時一個9級法術。當你完成長休後，你將重新獲得玄奧祕法的所有用途。
abilities.desc_en:
At 11th level, your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one spells|level=6|class=Warlock as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot. You must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

At higher levels, you gain more warlock spells of your choice that can be cast in this way: one 7th-level spell at 13th level, one 8th-level spell at 15th level, and one 9th-level spell at 17th level. You regain all uses of your Mystic Arcanum when you finish a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 13 級，你的異界宗主賜給你一個名為奧秘的魔法秘密。選擇一個法術|等級=7|職業=契術師作為這個奧秘。

你可以施放一次奧術法術，而無需消耗法術位。你必須完成長休才能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en:
At 13th level, your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one spells|level=7|class=Warlock as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot. You must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

abilities.desc_zh:
從第 14 級開始，你可以將生物帶入虛幻的境界。作為一個動作，選擇一個你在 60 呎範圍內可以看到的生物。它必須對你的契術師法術豁免 DC 進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它會被你（你的選擇）迷惑或恐懼一分鐘，或者直到你的注意力被打破（就好像你正在專注於一個法術）。如果生物受到任何傷害，效果會提前結束。

在這種幻象結束之前，該生物會認為自己迷失在一個迷霧國度中，其外觀由你選擇。該生物只能看到和聽到它自己、你和幻象。

你必須完成短休或長休才能再次使用此特性。

邪魔
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 14th level, you can plunge a creature into an illusory realm. As an action, choose a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you. It must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. On a failed save, it is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute or until your concentration is broken (as if you are concentrating on a spell). This effect ends early if the creature takes any damage.

Until this illusion ends, the creature thinks it is lost in a misty realm, the appearance of which you choose. The creature can see and hear only itself, you, and the illusion.

You must finish a short or long rest before you can use this feature again.

The Fiend

abilities.desc_zh:
從14級開始，當你攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使用此特性立即將目標傳送到較低的位面。該生物消失了，並衝過一片噩夢般的風景。

在你的下一個回合結束時，目標回到它之前佔據的空間，或是最近的未佔據的空間。如果目標不是惡魔，它會因可怕的經歷而受到 10d10 心靈傷害。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。

舊日支配者
abilities.desc_en:
Starting at 14th level, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape.

At the end of your next turn, the target returns to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space. If the target is not a fiend, it takes 10d10 psychic damage as it reels from its horrific experience.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

The Great Old One

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 14 級，你獲得了用你的守護神的外星魔法感染類人生物思想的能力。你可以用你的動作來觸摸一個失去能力的人形生物。然後該生物會被你魅惑，直到對它施放移除詛咒法術，魅惑狀態被移除，或者你再次使用此特性。

只要你們兩個處於同一存在平面，你們就可以與受迷惑的生物進行心靈感應交流。
abilities.desc_en:
At 14th level, you gain the ability to infect a humanoid's mind with the alien magic of your patron. You can use your action to touch an incapacitated humanoid. That creature is then charmed by you until a remove curse spell is cast on it, the charmed condition is removed from it, or you use this feature again.

You can communicate telepathically with the charmed creature as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence.

abilities.desc_zh:
15 級時，你的異界宗主賜給你一個名為奧秘的魔法秘密。選擇一個法術|等級=8|職業=契術師作為這個奧秘。

你可以施放一次奧術法術，而無需消耗法術位。你必須完成長休才能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en:
At 15th level, your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one spells|level=8|class=Warlock as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot. You must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

abilities.desc_zh:
在第 17 級，你的異界宗主賜給你一個名為奧秘的魔法秘密。選擇一個法術|等級=9|職業=契術師作為這個奧秘。

你可以施放一次奧術法術，而無需消耗法術位。你必須完成長休才能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en:
At 17th level, your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one spells|level=9|class=Warlock as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot. You must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

abilities.desc_zh: 在20級時，你可以利用你內在的神秘力量儲備，同時懇求你的宗主重新獲得消耗的法術位。你可以花 1 分鐘懇求你的宗主幫助你從 契約魔法 特性中重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。一旦你用這個特性重新獲得法術位，你必須完成長休才能再次這樣做。
abilities.desc_en: At 20th level, you can draw on your inner reserve of mystical power while entreating your patron to regain expended spell slots. You can spend 1 minute entreating your patron for aid to regain all your expended spell slots from your Pact Magic feature. Once you regain spell slots with this feature, you must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

abilities.desc_zh: 每日一次，完成短休後可恢復部分已消耗的法術位。恢復的法術位環級總和不得超過法師等級的一半（無條件進位），且不能恢復 6 環或更高環級的法術位。
abilities.desc_en: Once per day, after completing a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots. Their combined level cannot exceed half your wizard level, rounded up, and none can be 6th level or higher.

abilities.desc_zh:
18級時，你已經精通某些法術，可以隨意施展它們。選擇你的法術書中的一個 1 級巫師法術和一個 2 級巫師法術。當你準備好這些法術時，你可以在不花費法術位的情況下施放這些法術的最低等級。如果你想施展更高等級的法術，你必須像平常一樣消耗一個法術位。

花費8小時的學習時間，你可以將你選擇的一個或兩個法術交換為同等級的不同法術。
abilities.desc_en:
At 18th level, you have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a 1st-level wizard spell and a 2nd-level wizard spell that are in your spellbook. You can cast those spells at their lowest level without expending a spell slot when you have them prepared. If you want to cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot as normal.

By spending 8 hours in study, you can exchange one or both of the spells you chose for different spells of the same levels.

abilities.desc_zh:
當你達到20級時，你就可以掌握兩種強大的法術，並且可以毫不費力地施展它們。在你的法術書中選擇兩個3級巫師法術作為你的標誌法術。你總是準備好這些法術，它們不會計入你準備的法術數量，你可以在第3級施展每個法術一次，而無需花費法術位。當你這樣做時，在完成短休或長休之前，你無法再次這樣做。

如果你想施展更高等級的法術，你必須像平常一樣消耗一個法術位。
abilities.desc_en:
When you reach 20th level, you gain mastery over two powerful spells and can cast them with little effort. Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these spells prepared, they don't count against the number of spells you have prepared, and you can cast each of them once at 3rd level without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

If you want to cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot as normal.

• 選擇一種龍族祖先；祖先決定你的龍息傷害類型、範圍與豁免類型，也使你對該傷害類型具有抗性

• 語言：通用語、龍語
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Choose a draconic ancestry. It determines your breath weapon's damage type, area, and saving throw, and grants resistance to that damage type

Draconic Ancestry

| Dragon | Damage Type | Breath Weapon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Black | Acid | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Blue | Lightning | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Brass | Fire | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Bronze | Lightning | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Copper | Acid | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
