| Green | Poison | 15 ft. cone (Con. save) |
| Red | Fire | 15 ft. cone (Dex. save) |
| Silver | Cold | 15 ft. cone (Con. save) |
| White | Cold | 15 ft. cone (Con. save) |

• Creatures in the breath weapon's area make the specified saving throw, taking half damage on a success. You regain its use after a short or long rest
• Languages: Common and Draconic

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：25 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 對抗中毒的豁免具有優勢，且對毒性傷害具有抗性
• 熟練戰斧、手斧、輕錘與戰錘
• 從鐵匠工具、釀酒工具與石匠工具中選擇一項熟練
• 進行與石造物起源有關的智力（歷史）檢定時，視為具有歷史技能熟練，並加上雙倍熟練加值
• 語言：通用語、矮人語
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 25 feet
• Darkvision
• Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage
• Proficiency with battleaxes, handaxes, light hammers, and warhammers
• Choose proficiency with smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools
• On Intelligence (History) checks related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in History and add twice your proficiency bonus
• Languages: Common and Dwarvish

abilities.desc_zh:
感知+1

• 生命值上限額外 +1；此後每升一級再額外增加 1
abilities.desc_en:
WIS+1

• Your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level

abilities.desc_zh:
力量+2

• 你熟練輕甲與中甲
abilities.desc_en:
STR+2

• You are proficient with light and medium armor

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 熟練感知（觀察）技能
• 對抗魅惑的豁免具有優勢，且魔法無法使你入睡
• 無須睡眠；每日冥想 4 小時即可獲得等同人類睡眠 8 小時的休息效果，此狀態稱為「出神」（Trance）
• 語言：通用語、妖精語
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Proficiency in Perception
• Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; magic cannot put you to sleep
• You do not need to sleep. Four hours of daily meditation, called a trance, grants the same benefit a human receives from eight hours of sleep
• Languages: Common and Elvish

abilities.desc_zh:
智力+1

• 熟練長劍、短劍、短弓與長弓
• 從法師法術表選擇一個戲法；施法能力為智力
• 額外學會一種自選語言
abilities.desc_en:
INT+1

• Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows
• Choose one cantrip from the wizard spell list; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it
• Learn one additional language of your choice
proficiency_lan_en: One additional language of your choice

abilities.desc_zh:
感知+1

• 熟練長劍、短劍、短弓與長弓
• 速度：35 呎
• 在僅受樹葉、大雨、降雪、霧氣或其他自然現象輕度遮蔽時，仍可嘗試躲藏
abilities.desc_en:
WIS+1

• Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows
• Speed: 35 feet
• You can attempt to hide when lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or another natural phenomenon

abilities.desc_zh:
魅力+1

• 黑暗視覺範圍增加至 120 呎
• 當你、攻擊目標或你試圖觀察的事物位於陽光直射下時，依賴視覺的攻擊檢定與感知（觀察）檢定具有劣勢
• 會施放「舞光術」（Dancing Lights）戲法。3 級起，每次長休可施放一次「妖火術」（Faerie Fire）；5 級起，每次長休可施放一次「黑暗術」（Darkness）。這些法術的施法能力皆為魅力
• 熟練細劍、短劍與手弩
abilities.desc_en:
CHA+1

• Darkvision extends to 120 feet
• You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, your target, or what you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight
• You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Faerie Fire once per long rest; at 5th level, you can cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells
• Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：25 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 地侏狡猾：對抗魔法的智力、感知與魅力豁免具有優勢
• 語言：通用語、地侏語；地侏語使用矮人文字書寫
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 25 feet
• Darkvision
• Gnome Cunning: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic
• Languages: Common and Gnomish; Gnomish uses Dwarvish script

abilities.desc_zh:
敏捷+1

• 可施放「小幻象」（Minor Illusion）戲法；施法能力為智力
• 可透過聲音與姿勢，向小型或更小的野獸傳達簡單概念
abilities.desc_en:
DEX+1

• You can cast the Minor Illusion cantrip; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it
• Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas to Small or smaller beasts

abilities.desc_zh:
體魄+1

• 進行與魔法物品、煉金物品或科技裝置有關的智力（歷史）檢定時，加上雙倍熟練加值
• 熟練工匠工具（修補匠工具）。可花費 1 小時與價值 10 gp 的材料，製作能運作 24 小時的微型發條裝置：發條玩具、點火器或音樂盒
abilities.desc_en:
CON+1

• Add twice your proficiency bonus to Intelligence (History) checks related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices
• Proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). By spending 1 hour and 10 gp in materials, you can create a Tiny clockwork device that functions for 24 hours: a clockwork toy, fire starter, or music box

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 妖精血統：對抗魅惑的豁免具有優勢，且魔法無法使你入睡
• 技能多才：熟練兩項自選技能
• 語言：通用語、妖精語，以及一種自選語言
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Fey Ancestry: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; magic cannot put you to sleep
• Skill Versatility: Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice
• Languages: Common, Elvish, and one additional language of your choice
proficiency_lan_en: one additional language of your choice

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 熟練魅力（威嚇）技能
• 堅韌不屈：當生命值降至 0，但沒有立即死亡時，可改為剩下 1 點生命值；每次長休後可再次使用
• 凶蠻攻擊：使用近戰武器造成重擊時，可額外擲一次該武器的一顆傷害骰，並加到重擊的額外傷害中
• 語言：通用語、獸人語；獸人語使用矮人文字書寫
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Proficiency in Intimidation
• Relentless Endurance: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You regain this ability after a long rest
• Savage Attacks: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die and add it to the critical hit's extra damage
• Languages: Common and Orc; Orc uses Dwarvish script

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：25 呎
• 半身人幸運：攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免骰擲出 1 時，可重擲該骰一次，並必須採用新的結果
• 勇敢：對抗恐懼的豁免具有優勢
• 半身人靈巧：可穿越體型比你大的生物所占據的空間
• 語言：通用語、半身人語

註：「半身人幸運」與「幸運」專長（Lucky feat）是不同能力。
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 25 feet
• Lucky: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die once and must use the new result
• Brave: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
• Halfling Nimbleness: You can move through the space of a creature larger than you
• Languages: Common and Halfling

Note: The halfling's Lucky trait is different from the Lucky feat.

abilities.desc_zh:
魅力+1

• 可嘗試躲在體型比你大的生物後方
abilities.desc_en:
CHA+1

• You can attempt to hide behind a creature larger than you

abilities.desc_zh:
體魄+1

• 對抗中毒的豁免具有優勢，且對毒性傷害具有抗性
abilities.desc_en:
CON+1

• Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 語言：通用語，以及一種自選語言
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Languages: Common and one additional language of your choice
proficiency_lan_en: one additional language of your choice

abilities.desc_zh:
自選兩項不同能力值各+1

變體人類以以下特性取代一般人類的能力值提升：

• 熟練一項自選技能
• 獲得一項自選專長（feat）
abilities.desc_en:
Choose 2 Different Abilities, Each +1

The variant human replaces the standard human's ability score increase with the following traits:

• Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice
• Gain one feat of your choice

abilities.desc_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 對火焰傷害具有抗性
• 可施放「奇術」（Thaumaturgy）戲法。3 級起，每次長休可用 2 環施放一次「煉獄叱喝」（Hellish Rebuke）；5 級起，每次長休可施放一次「黑暗術」（Darkness）。這些法術的施法能力皆為魅力
• 語言：通用語、煉獄語
abilities.desc_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Resistance to fire damage
• You can cast the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest; at 5th level, you can cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells
• Languages: Common and Infernal

abilities.desc_zh: 魅力 +1（最高 20）；擅長模仿他人的聲音與姿態，並在偽裝成他人時更容易蒙混過關。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Charisma by 1 (maximum 20); improve voice and mannerism mimicry and deception while impersonating someone.

abilities.desc_zh: 先攻獲得 +5 加值；保持清醒時不會被突襲，且看不見的敵人不會因隱匿而取得對你的攻擊優勢。
abilities.desc_en: Gain +5 initiative, cannot be surprised while conscious, and unseen attackers gain no advantage solely from being unseen.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20）；起立消耗更少移動力，攀爬更快，並可在助跑後跳得更遠。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20); stand faster, climb faster, and make longer running jumps.

abilities.desc_zh: 以疾走動作直線移動至少 10 呎後，可用附贈動作近戰攻擊或推撞；命中時可強化傷害或推遠目標。
abilities.desc_en: After dashing at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, use a bonus action to attack or shove it; an attack can gain extra damage or a shove can push farther.

abilities.desc_zh: 忽略弩的裝填限制；近戰敵人不會使你的遠程攻擊劣勢；以單手武器攻擊後可用附贈動作射擊手弩。
abilities.desc_en: Ignore crossbow loading, avoid disadvantage on ranged attacks from nearby foes, and fire a hand crossbow as a bonus action after a one-handed-weapon attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 持用靈巧武器時，可用反應將熟練加值加到一次針對你的近戰攻擊 AC 上。
abilities.desc_en: While wielding a finesse weapon, use a reaction to add your proficiency bonus to AC against one melee attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 雙持時 AC +1；可雙持非輕型單手近戰武器，並可在同一次互動中拔出或收起兩把單手武器。
abilities.desc_en: Gain +1 AC while dual wielding, use two non-light one-handed melee weapons, and draw or stow two one-handed weapons together.

abilities.desc_zh: 更善於發現祕門與陷阱；對陷阱豁免有優勢、陷阱傷害減半，並可更快搜尋祕門。
abilities.desc_en: Improve detection of secret doors and traps; gain advantage on saves against traps, resistance to their damage, and search for secret doors faster.

abilities.desc_zh: 體質 +1（最高 20）；花費生命骰恢復生命值時，每顆骰的最低恢復量為體質調整值的兩倍。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Constitution by 1 (maximum 20); when spending Hit Dice, each die restores at least twice your Constitution modifier.

abilities.desc_zh: 選擇一種傷害類型（酸、冷、火、閃電或雷鳴）；你的法術忽略該類型抗性，且傷害骰的 1 視為 2。
abilities.desc_en: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to it, and damage die rolls of 1 count as 2.

abilities.desc_zh: 對被你擒抱的生物進行攻擊時具有優勢，並可嘗試讓自己與對方同時陷入束縛。
abilities.desc_en: Gain advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple and can attempt to restrain both yourself and the grappled target.

abilities.desc_zh: 近戰重擊或將敵人生命值降至 0 時，可附贈動作再攻擊一次；重型武器攻擊可選擇承受命中減值以換取大幅傷害加值。
abilities.desc_en: After a melee critical hit or reducing a creature to 0 hit points, make a bonus-action attack; take an attack-roll penalty with a heavy weapon for substantial bonus damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量 +1（最高 20），並獲得重甲熟練。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with heavy armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量 +1（最高 20）；穿著重甲時，非魔法武器造成的鈍擊、穿刺、揮砍傷害會減少。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength by 1 (maximum 20); while wearing heavy armor, reduce nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapons.

abilities.desc_zh: 花 10 分鐘鼓舞同伴，讓最多六名生物獲得臨時生命值；休息後可再次使用。
abilities.desc_en: Spend 10 minutes inspiring up to six creatures, granting temporary hit points; use again after a rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 智力 +1（最高 20）；能辨識方位、知道日出日落前的剩餘時間，並能精確回憶近期所見所聞。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Intelligence by 1 (maximum 20); always know direction, time to sunrise or sunset, and accurately recall recent sights and sounds.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得輕甲熟練。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with light armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 智力 +1（最高 20）；學會三種語言，並可創造他人難以破譯的書寫密碼。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Intelligence by 1 (maximum 20), learn three languages, and create written ciphers others struggle to decipher.

abilities.desc_zh: 獲得幸運點，可在攻擊、能力檢定、豁免或敵人攻擊你時擲額外 d20 並選擇結果；長休後恢復。
abilities.desc_en: Gain luck points to roll an extra d20 for your attacks, checks, saves, or an attack against you and choose the result; regain them after a long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 附近敵人施法時可用反應近戰攻擊；可擾亂其專注，並對其法術豁免具有優勢。
abilities.desc_en: React with a melee attack when a nearby creature casts a spell; disrupt its concentration and gain advantage on saves against its spells.

abilities.desc_zh: 選擇一個職業的法術列表，學會兩個戲法及一個一環法術；該一環法術每次長休可免費施展一次。
abilities.desc_en: Choose a class spell list, learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell; cast that spell once for free per long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 學會兩個戰鬥大師戰技，並獲得一顆較小的卓越骰；短休或長休後恢復。
abilities.desc_en: Learn two Battle Master maneuvers and gain one smaller superiority die, restored on a short or long rest.

abilities.desc_zh: 穿中甲不再有潛行劣勢，且可將更高的敏捷調整值加入 AC。
abilities.desc_en: Medium armor no longer imposes Stealth disadvantage and permits a higher Dexterity contribution to AC.

abilities.desc_zh: 速度增加；疾走時可忽略困難地形；近戰攻擊過的生物當回合無法藉機會攻擊阻止你離開。
abilities.desc_en: Increase speed, ignore difficult terrain while dashing, and avoid opportunity attacks from creatures you have made a melee attack against that turn.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得中甲與盾牌熟練。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

abilities.desc_zh: 騎乘時可保護坐騎免受攻擊；對較小的未騎乘生物近戰攻擊有優勢，且坐騎敏捷豁免成功時可免受傷害。
abilities.desc_en: While mounted, protect your mount from attacks, gain advantage on melee attacks against smaller unmounted creatures, and let your mount take no damage on successful Dexterity saves.

abilities.desc_zh: 智力或感知 +1（最高 20）；能讀唇語，且被動感知與被動調查提高。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Intelligence or Wisdom by 1 (maximum 20); read lips and improve passive Perception and Investigation.

abilities.desc_zh: 以長柄武器攻擊後可用附贈動作以武器另一端攻擊；生物進入你的觸及範圍時會引發機會攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: After attacking with a qualifying polearm, make a bonus-action butt-end attack; creatures entering your reach provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 一項屬性 +1（最高 20），並獲得該屬性的豁免熟練。
abilities.desc_en: Increase one ability score by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.
proficiency_save_en: Saving throws using the chosen ability

abilities.desc_zh: 獲得儀式書，可選擇一個職業法術列表中的兩個一環儀式法術，並可持續把新的儀式加入書中。
abilities.desc_en: Gain a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from one class list and the ability to add additional ritual spells to it.

abilities.desc_zh: 每回合一次，近戰武器攻擊造成傷害時可重擲傷害骰並選擇使用其中一個結果。
abilities.desc_en: Once per turn when rolling melee-weapon damage, reroll the damage dice and use either total.

abilities.desc_zh: 機會攻擊命中會使目標速度歸零；敵人即使撤離也會引發你的機會攻擊，且可反應攻擊打向同伴的附近敵人。
abilities.desc_en: Your opportunity-attack hits stop movement; foes provoke even when disengaging, and you can react to attack a nearby foe targeting an ally.

abilities.desc_zh: 遠程攻擊忽略遠距離劣勢與大部分掩蔽；可選擇承受命中減值以換取大幅傷害加值。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged attacks ignore long-range disadvantage and most cover; take an attack-roll penalty for substantial bonus damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 攻擊動作中先以單手武器攻擊後，可附贈動作推撞；盾牌可協助敏捷豁免，並在部分成功豁免時避免傷害。
abilities.desc_en: After a one-handed weapon attack in your Attack action, bonus-action shove; your shield helps on Dexterity saves and can prevent damage from certain successful saves.

abilities.desc_zh: 獲得任選三項技能或工具熟練。
abilities.desc_en: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

abilities.desc_zh: 昏暗光線不會妨礙依靠視覺的感知；躲藏時未命中的遠程攻擊不會暴露你的位置，且可更容易躲在略被遮蔽處。
abilities.desc_en: Dim light does not hinder sight-based Perception; missed ranged attacks while hidden do not reveal you, and you can hide more easily when lightly obscured.

abilities.desc_zh: 施放需要攻擊擲骰的法術時，射程加倍且忽略半掩蔽與四分之三掩蔽；另學會一個攻擊戲法。
abilities.desc_en: Double range for spells requiring attack rolls, ignore half and three-quarters cover, and learn one attack cantrip.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量或體質 +1（最高 20）；徒手打擊更強、獲得即興武器熟練，且攻擊命中後可附贈動作嘗試擒抱。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1 (maximum 20); improve unarmed strikes, gain improvised-weapon proficiency, and bonus-action grapple after a hit.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的生命值上限會隨等級獲得額外提升，並追溯計入已取得的等級。
abilities.desc_en: Your hit point maximum increases with your level, including retroactively for levels already gained.

abilities.desc_zh: 進行專注豁免時具優勢；手持武器或盾牌也能施展姿勢成分法術；可用單一目標法術進行機會攻擊。
abilities.desc_en: Gain advantage on concentration saves, cast somatic spells with weapons or a shield in hand, and use a single-target spell for opportunity attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得任選四種簡易或軍用武器熟練。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice.

abilities.desc_zh: 你與同伴可在同信仰的神殿獲得免費治療與照料；仍須自行提供法術所需的材料成分。
abilities.desc_en: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith; you still provide any material spell components.

abilities.desc_zh: 你擁有一個可用的第二身分，並備有相應的文件、人脈與偽裝。
abilities.desc_en: You maintain a usable second identity with its supporting documents, contacts, and disguises.

abilities.desc_zh: 你有可靠的地下聯絡人，可協助在你與犯罪網絡之間傳遞訊息。
abilities.desc_en: You have a reliable underworld contact who can pass messages between you and a criminal network.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可藉由表演換取免費食宿；熟識你的群眾通常也願意協助安排。
abilities.desc_en: You can earn free food and lodging through performance, and appreciative audiences may help arrange it.

abilities.desc_zh: 平民會將你視為自己人，願意提供住處、隱匿處或協助躲避追捕。
abilities.desc_en: Common folk see you as one of their own and may offer shelter, concealment, or help evade pursuit.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可向工會成員求助，並可使用工會設施；通常須維持會費與會員義務。
abilities.desc_en: You can seek aid from guild members and use guild facilities, normally while keeping up dues and obligations.

abilities.desc_zh: 你的隱居生活帶來一項重要發現；其具體內容由你與 DM 決定。
abilities.desc_en: Your isolated life gave you an important discovery; its specific nature is decided with the DM.

abilities.desc_zh: 上流社會承認你的身分：你能進入高階場所，並較容易獲得平民的接待與協助。
abilities.desc_en: High society recognizes your status: you can access elevated circles and more readily receive commoners’ hospitality and aid.

abilities.desc_zh: 你能準確記住地形與地圖，並可為至多六人每天找到足夠的食物與飲水。
abilities.desc_en: You accurately recall terrain and maps, and can find enough food and water for up to six people each day.

abilities.desc_zh: 若你不知道某段知識，通常知道要去哪裡、向誰查找答案。
abilities.desc_en: When you do not know a piece of lore, you generally know where or from whom to seek the answer.

abilities.desc_zh: 你可為自己與同伴取得帆船上的免費乘船機會，但船隻航向與時間由船長決定。
abilities.desc_en: You can secure free passage for yourself and companions on a sailing vessel, subject to the captain’s route and schedule.

abilities.desc_zh: 與你曾同屬的軍事組織會承認你的階級；你可在合理範圍內指揮低階人員與徵用基本支援。
abilities.desc_en: Your former military organization recognizes your rank; within reason, you can direct lower-ranking personnel and requisition basic support.

abilities.desc_zh: 你熟悉城市的祕徑與暗巷；非戰鬥時，在城市中可比一般速度更快地往返兩地。
abilities.desc_en: You know a city’s hidden routes and alleys; outside combat, you can move between its locations faster than usual.
